text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad Al Naheyki, from Ammar Bin Marwan Al Qandy, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘There is neither a small (sin) along with the persistence (upon it), nor is there a major (sin) along with the (seeking of) Forgiveness’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:114
citation.arabic_text: لَا صَغِيرَةَ مَعَ الْإِصْرَارِ وَ لَا كَبِيرَةَ مَعَ الِاسْتِغْفَارِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad Al Naheyki, from Ammar Bin Marwan Al Qandy, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘There is neither a small (sin) along with the persistence (upon it), nor is there a major (sin) along with the (seeking of) Forgiveness’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/70)

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Salim, from Ahmad Bin Al Nazar, from Amro Bin Shimr, form Jabir, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [3:135] and (who) do not knowingly persist in what they have done. Heasws said: ‘The persistence, it is when he commits the sins, but he does not seek the Forgiveness of Allahazwj nor does he discuss the repentance with himself. So that is the persistence’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:114
citation.arabic_text: اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ لَمْ يُصِرُّوا عَلى ما فَعَلُوا وَ هُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ قَالَ الْإِصْرَارُ هُوَ أَنْ يُذْنِبَ الذَّنْبَ فَلَا يَسْتَغْفِرَ اللَّهَ وَ لَا يُحَدِّثَ نَفْسَهُ بِتَوْبَةٍ فَذَلِكَ الْإِصْرَارُ .
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Salim, from Ahmad Bin Al Nazar, from Amro Bin Shimr, form Jabir, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [3:135] and (who) do not knowingly persist in what they have done. Heasws said: ‘The persistence, it is when he commits the sins, but he does not seek the Forgiveness of Allahazwj nor does he discuss the repentance with himself. So that is the persistence’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/72)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Mansour Bin Yunus, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘No, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will not Accept anything from his obedience, upon his persistence upon something from his disobedience’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:114
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ لَا وَ اللَّهِ لَا يَقْبَلُ اللَّهُ شَيْئاً مِنْ طَاعَتِهِ عَلَى الْإِصْرَارِ عَلَى شَيْ‏ءٍ مِنْ مَعَاصِيهِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Mansour Bin Yunus, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘No, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will not Accept anything from his obedience, upon his persistence upon something from his disobedience’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/73)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Bakr Bin Muhammad, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The origins of the disbelief are three – the greed, and the arrogance, and the envy. So, as for the greed, so when Adam<sup>as</sup> was Forbidden from the tree, the greed carried him<sup>as</sup> upon eating from it; and as for the arrogance, so when Iblees<sup>la</sup> was Commanded with the prostration to Adam<sup>as</sup>, he<sup>la</sup> refused; and as for the envy, so when the two sons of Adam<sup>as</sup>, one of the two killed his companion’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:115
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) أُصُولُ الْكُفْرِ ثَلَاثَةٌ الْحِرْصُ وَ الِاسْتِكْبَارُ وَ الْحَسَدُ فَأَمَّا الْحِرْصُ فَإِنَّ آدَمَ ( عليه السلام ) حِينَ نُهِيَ عَنِ الشَّجَرَةِ حَمَلَهُ الْحِرْصُ عَلَى أَنْ أَكَلَ مِنْهَا وَ أَمَّا الِاسْتِكْبَارُ فَإِبْلِيسُ حَيْثُ أُمِرَ بِالسُّجُودِ لآِدَمَ فَأَبَى وَ أَمَّا الْحَسَدُ فَابْنَا آدَمَ حَيْثُ قَتَلَ أَحَدُهُمَا صَاحِبَهُ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Bakr Bin Muhammad, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The origins of the disbelief are three – the greed, and the arrogance, and the envy. So, as for the greed, so when Adam<sup>as</sup> was Forbidden from the tree, the greed carried him<sup>as</sup> upon eating from it; and as for the arrogance, so when Iblees<sup>la</sup> was Commanded with the prostration to Adam<sup>as</sup>, he<sup>la</sup> refused; and as for the envy, so when the two sons of Adam<sup>as</sup>, one of the two killed his companion’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/73)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The corner-stones of the disbelief are four – the desire, and the awe, and the resentment, and the anger’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:115
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَرْكَانُ الْكُفْرِ أَرْبَعَةٌ الرَّغْبَةُ وَ الرَّهْبَةُ وَ السَّخَطُ وَ الْغَضَبُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The corner-stones of the disbelief are four – the desire, and the awe, and the resentment, and the anger’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/74)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Nuh Bin Shuayb, from Abdullah Al Dihqan, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The first of what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic was disobeyed with were six – love of the world, and love of the governing, and love of the food, and love of the sleep, and love of the rest, and love of the women’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:115
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِنَّ أَوَّلَ مَا عُصِيَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِهِ سِتٌّ حُبُّ الدُّنْيَا وَ حُبُّ الرِّئَاسَةِ وَ حُبُّ الطَّعَامِ وَ حُبُّ النَّوْمِ وَ حُبُّ الرَّاحَةِ وَ حُبُّ النِّسَاءِ .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Talha Bin Zayd, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man from Khas’am came over to the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> and he said, ‘Which of the deeds is the most Hated one to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The association (Shirk) with Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’. He said, ‘Then what?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Cutting off the relationship’. He said, ‘Then what?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Enjoining of the evil and forbidding from the good’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:115
citation.arabic_text: أَيُّ الْأَعْمَالِ أَبْغَضُ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَقَالَ الشِّرْكُ بِاللَّهِ قَالَ ثُمَّ مَا ذَا قَالَ قَطِيعَةُ الرَّحِمِ قَالَ ثُمَّ مَا ذَا قَالَ الْأَمْرُ بِالْمُنْكَرِ وَ النَّهْيُ عَنِ الْمَعْرُوفِ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from hasan Bin Atiyya, from Yazeed Al Sa’ig who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘A man of this matter (Al-Willayah), if he narrates he lies, and if he promises he breaks, and if he is entrusted he betrays. What is his status?’ Heasws said: ‘It is the closest of the levels from the disbelief, but he is not a disbeliever’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:115
citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) رَجُلٌ عَلَى هَذَا الْأَمْرِ إِنْ حَدَّثَ كَذَبَ وَ إِنْ وَعَدَ أَخْلَفَ وَ إِنِ ائْتُمِنَ خَانَ مَا مَنْزِلَتُهُ قَالَ هِيَ أَدْنَى الْمَنَازِلِ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَ لَيْسَ بِكَافِرٍ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘From the signs of the wretchedness is the lustfulness of the eyes, and the harshness of the heart, and the intenseness of the greed in seeking the world, and the persistence upon the sin’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:115
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مِنْ عَلَامَاتِ الشَّقَاءِ جُمُودُ الْعَيْنِ وَ قَسْوَةُ الْقَلْبِ وَ شِدَّةُ الْحِرْصِ فِي طَلَبِ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْإِصْرَارُ عَلَى الذَّنْبِ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Dawood Bin Al Nu’man, from Abu Hamza, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww addressed the people, so hesaww said: ‘Shall Isaww inform you of the most evil of you all?’ They said, ‘Yes, O Rssool-Allahsaww! The one who prevents his gifts, and strikes his slave, and provides from himself alone. Allahazwj did not Create a creature who is more evil than this’. Then hesaww said: ‘Shall Isaww inform you of the one who is more evil than that?’ They said, ‘Yes, O Rasool-Allahsaww! Hesaww said: ‘The one whose goodness is not hoped for nor is there a safety from his evil’. So they thought that Allahazwj has not Created a creature who is more evil than this. Then heasws said: ‘Shall Isaww infrom you of the one who is more evil than that?’ They said, ‘Yes, O Rasool-Allahsaww! Hesaww said: ‘He is a foulmouth, profane person. The one who, when the Momineen are mentioned in his presence, he curses them, and when they mention him, (they) condemn him’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:115

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from one of his companions, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abdu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Three (things), the one who has these in him, would be a hypocrite, and even if he were to Fast, and pray Salāt, and claims that he is a Muslim. The one who, when entrusted, betrays, when he narrates, lies, and when he promises, breaks. Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying in Hisazwj Book [8:58] surely Allah does not love the treacherous. And Heazwj Said [24:7] then the Curse of Allah be on him if he was one of the liars. And in the Words of the Mighty and Majestic [19:54] And mention Ismail in the Book; he was truthful in (his) promise, and he was a Rasool, a Prophet’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:115

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from one of his companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Alllah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Shall I<sup>saww</sup> inform you of the ones who are the most remote from me<sup>saww</sup> in likeness?’ They said, ‘Yes, O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>!’. He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The immoral, the scandalous, the foul-mouthed, the stingy, the rogue, the malicious, the envious, the hard of heart, the one remote from every hope of goodness without any safety from every evil feared’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:115
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَ لَا أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِأَبْعَدِكُمْ مِنِّي شَبَهاً قَالُوا بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ الْفَاحِشُ الْمُتَفَحِّشُ الْبَذِي‏ءُ الْبَخِيلُ الْمُخْتَالُ الْحَقُودُ الْحَسُودُ الْقَاسِي الْقَلْبِ الْبَعِيدُ مِنْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ يُرْجَى غَيْرُ الْمَأْمُونِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ يُتَّقَى .

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Ali Bin Asbat, raising it to Salman who said, ‘(Heasws said): ‘Whenever Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Intends to Destroy a servant, Removes the bashfulness from him. So when the bashfulness is Removed from him, you will not meet him except as a deceitful and causing deception. So when he was deceitful and causing deception, the entrustments would be removed from him. So when the entrustments are Removed from him, you will not meet him except as rude and harsh. So when he was rude and harsh, the yoke of Emān is Removed from him, you will not meet him except as a Satanla, accursed’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:115
citation.arabic_text: إِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ هَلَاكَ عَبْدٍ نَزَعَ مِنْهُ الْحَيَاءَ فَإِذَا نَزَعَ مِنْهُ الْحَيَاءَ لَمْ تَلْقَهُ إِلَّا خَائِناً مَخُوناً فَإِذَا كَانَ خَائِناً مَخُوناً نُزِعَتْ مِنْهُ الْأَمَانَةُ فَإِذَا نُزِعَتْ مِنْهُ الْأَمَانَةُ لَمْ تَلْقَهُ إِلَّا فَظّاً غَلِيظاً فَإِذَا كَانَ فَظّاً غَلِيظاً نُزِعَتْ مِنْهُ رِبْقَةُ الْإِيمَانِ فَإِذَا نُزِعَتْ مِنْهُ رِبْقَةُ الْإِيمَانِ لَمْ تَلْقَهُ إِلَّا شَيْطَاناً مَلْعُوناً .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Abu Hamza, (It has been narrated) from Jabir Bin Abdullah who said, ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Shall I<sup>saww</sup> inform you all with the most evil of your men?’ We said, ‘Yes, O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘From the most evil of your men is the slanderer, the audaciously immoral, the lone eater, and the preventer of the gifts, and the whipper of his slave, and the causer of his family taking shelter with others’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:115
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَ لَا أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِشِرَارِ رِجَالِكُمْ قُلْنَا بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ مِنْ شِرَارِ رِجَالِكُمُ الْبَهَّاتَ الْجَرِي‏ءَ الْفَحَّاشَ الْآكِلَ وَحْدَهُ وَ الْمَانِعَ رِفْدَهُ وَ الضَّارِبَ عَبْدَهُ وَ الْمُلْجِئَ عِيَالَهُ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Abu Hamza, (It has been narrated) from Jabir Bin Abdullah who said, ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Shall I<sup>saww</sup> inform you all with the most evil of your men?’ We said, ‘Yes, O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘From the most evil of your men is the slanderer, the audaciously immoral, the lone eater, and the preventer of the gifts, and the whipper of his slave, and the causer of his family taking shelter with others’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/85)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muyassar, from his father, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘There are five that Isaww curse, and so did every Prophetsaww who was Answered – The increaser in the Book of Allahazwj, and the neglecter of mysaww Sunnah, and the belier of the Ordainment of Allahazwj, and the legalizer from mysaww offspring what Allahazwj has Prohibited, and the mis-appropriator of Al-Fey (Khums) and the legalizer for himself’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:115
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) خَمْسَةٌ لَعَنْتُهُمْ وَ كُلُّ نَبِيٍّ مُجَابٍ الزَّائِدُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَ التَّارِكُ لِسُنَّتِي وَ الْمُكَذِّبُ بِقَدَرِ اللَّهِ وَ الْمُسْتَحِلُّ مِنْ عِتْرَتِي مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ وَ الْمُسْتَأْثِرُ بِالْفَيْ‏ءِ وَ الْمُسْتَحِلُّ لَهُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muyassar, from his father, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘There are five that Isaww curse, and so did every Prophetsaww who was Answered – The increaser in the Book of Allahazwj, and the neglecter of mysaww Sunnah, and the belier of the Ordainment of Allahazwj, and the legalizer from mysaww offspring what Allahazwj has Prohibited, and the mis-appropriator of Al-Fey (Khums) and the legalizer for himself’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/86)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said to Abd Bin Kaseer Al-Basry in the Masjid: ‘Woe be unto you Abbad! Beware of the showing-off, for it is from the deeds (done) for other than Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will Allocate him to the one he worked for’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: لِعَبَّادِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ الْبَصْرِيِّ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَيْلَكَ يَا عَبَّادُ إِيَّاكَ وَ الرِّيَاءَ فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ عَمِلَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ وَكَلَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَى مَنْ عَمِلَ لَهُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said to Abd Bin Kaseer Al-Basry in the Masjid: ‘Woe be unto you Abbad! Beware of the showing-off, for it is from the deeds (done) for other than Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will Allocate him to the one he worked for’.

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali Bin Uqba, from his father who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Make this matter of yours (Al-Wilayah) to be for Allahazwj, and do not make it to be for the people, for whatever was (performed) for Allahazwj, so it would be for Allahazwj, and whatever was (performed) for the people, so it would not ascend to Allahazwj’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ اجْعَلُوا أَمْرَكُمْ هَذَا لِلَّهِ وَ لَا تَجْعَلُوهُ لِلنَّاسِ فَإِنَّهُ مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ فَهُوَ لِلَّهِ وَ مَا كَانَ لِلنَّاسِ فَلَا يَصْعَدُ إِلَى اللَّهِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali Bin Uqba, from his father who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Make this matter of yours (Al-Wilayah) to be for Allahazwj, and do not make it to be for the people, for whatever was (performed) for Allahazwj, so it would be for Allahazwj, and whatever was (performed) for the people, so it would not ascend to Allahazwj’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/103)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Al Magra’a, from Yazeed Bin Khaleefa who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Showing-off is Shirk (association with Allah<sup>azwj</sup>). The one who does a deed for the people, his rewards would be upon the people, and the one who does a deed for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, his Reward would be upon Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) كُلُّ رِيَاءٍ شِرْكٌ إِنَّهُ مَنْ عَمِلَ لِلنَّاسِ كَانَ ثَوَابُهُ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَ مَنْ عَمِلَ لِلَّهِ كَانَ ثَوَابُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Al Magra’a, from Yazeed Bin Khaleefa who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Showing-off is Shirk (association with Allah<sup>azwj</sup>). The one who does a deed for the people, his rewards would be upon the people, and the one who does a deed for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, his Reward would be upon Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/104)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Al Qasim Bin Suleyman, from Jarrah Al Madainy, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [18:110] therefore whoever hopes to meet his Lord, so he should do righteous deeds, and not associate anyone in the worship of his Lord. Heasws said: ‘The man does something from the Reward-able deeds, not seeking the Face of the Allahazwj by it, but rather for purifying the people desiring that the people would hear him with it (become famous). So this is the one who is associating (committing Shirk) with the worship of his Lordazwj’. Then heasws said: ‘There is none from a servant who does good deeds secretly, so the days go by for ever until Allahazwj would Manifest goodness for him, and there is none from a servant who does an evil deed secretly, so the days would go by forever until Allahazwj would Manifest the evil for him’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَمَنْ كانَ يَرْجُوا لِقاءَ رَبِّهِ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صالِحاً وَ لا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبادَةِ رَبِّهِ أَحَداً قَالَ الرَّجُلُ يَعْمَلُ شَيْئاً مِنَ الثَّوَابِ لَا يَطْلُبُ بِهِ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا يَطْلُبُ تَزْكِيَةَ النَّاسِ يَشْتَهِي أَنْ يُسْمِعَ بِهِ النَّاسَ فَهَذَا الَّذِي أَشْرَكَ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ أَسَرَّ خَيْراً فَذَهَبَتِ الْأَيَّامُ أَبَداً حَتَّى يُظْهِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ خَيْراً وَ مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُسِرُّ شَرّاً فَذَهَبَتِ الْأَيَّامُ أَبَداً حَتَّى يُظْهِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ شَرّاً .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Al Qasim Bin Suleyman, from Jarrah Al Madainy, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [18:110] therefore whoever hopes to meet his Lord, so he should do righteous deeds, and not associate anyone in the worship of his Lord. Heasws said: ‘The man does something from the Reward-able deeds, not seeking the Face of the Allahazwj by it, but rather for purifying the people desiring that the people would hear him with it (become famous). So this is the one who is associating (committing Shirk) with the worship of his Lordazwj’. text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa Bin Ubeyd, from Muhammad Bin Arafa who said, ‘Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Woe be unto you, O Ibn Arafa! For it is such that the one who does a deed for other than Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Allocate it to what he worked for. Woe be unto you! There is no deed which anyone does except Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Returns it as such – so if it is good, so good, and if evil, so evil’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لِيَ الرِّضَا ( عليه السلام ) وَيْحَكَ يَا ابْنَ عَرَفَةَ اعْمَلُوا لِغَيْرِ رِيَاءٍ وَ لَا سُمْعَةٍ فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ عَمِلَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ وَكَلَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَى مَا عَمِلَ وَيْحَكَ مَا عَمِلَ أَحَدٌ عَمَلًا إِلَّا رَدَّاهُ اللَّهُ إِنْ خَيْراً فَخَيْرٌ وَ إِنْ شَرّاً فَشَرٌّ .

There is no deed which anyone does except Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Returns it as such – so if it is good, so good, and if evil, so evil’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/107)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Umar Bin Yazeed who said, ‘I was having dinner with Abu Abdullahasws when heasws recited this Verse [75:14] But! The human being is evidence against himself [75:15] Although he puts forth his excuses. O Abu Hafs! The human being cannot get closer to Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic by going against what Allahazwj the Exalted Knows. Rasool-Allahsaww was saying: ‘The one who does a secretive deed, Allahazwj would Return it with a Returning - if it was good, so good, and if it was evil, so evil’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: إِنِّي لَأَتَعَشَّى مَعَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِذْ تَلَا هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ بَلِ الْإِنْسانُ عَلى نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ وَ لَوْ أَلْقى مَعاذِيرَهُ يَا أَبَا حَفْصٍ مَا يَصْنَعُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنْ يَتَقَرَّبَ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِخِلَافِ مَا يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) كَانَ يَقُولُ مَنْ أَسَرَّ سَرِيرَةً رَدَّاهُ اللَّهُ رِدَاءَهَا إِنْ خَيْراً فَخَيْرٌ وَ إِنْ شَرّاً فَشَرٌّ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Umar Bin Yazeed who said, ‘I was having dinner with Abu Abdullahasws when heasws recited this Verse [75:14] But! The human being is evidence against himself [75:15] Although he puts forth his excuses. O Abu Hafs! The human being cannot get closer to Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic by going against what Allahazwj the Exalted Knows. Rasool-Allahsaww was saying: ‘The one who does a secretive deed, Allahazwj would Return it with a Returning - if it was good, so good, and if it was evil, so evil’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/108)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The Angel joyfully ascends with the deed of the servant. So when he ascends with his good deed, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is Saying: “Make it to be in the Sijjeen (a Register of deeds of evil people), it is not I<sup>azwj</sup> He<sup>azwj</sup> intended with it’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِنَّ الْمَلَكَ لَيَصْعَدُ بِعَمَلِ الْعَبْدِ مُبْتَهِجاً بِهِ فَإِذَا صَعِدَ بِحَسَنَاتِهِ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ اجْعَلُوهَا فِي سِجِّينٍ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ إِيَّايَ أَرَادَ بِهَا .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The Angel joyfully ascends with the deed of the servant. So when he ascends with his good deed, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is Saying: “Make it to be in the Sijjeen (a Register of deeds of evil people), it is not I<sup>azwj</sup> He<sup>azwj</sup> intended with it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/109)

text: And by his chain, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There are three signs for the show-off – He is active when he sees the people (around him), and he is lazy when he is alone, and he loves to be praised in the entirety of his affairs’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: وَ بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) ثَلَاثُ عَلَامَاتٍ لِلْمُرَائِي يَنْشَطُ إِذَا رَأَى النَّاسَ وَ يَكْسَلُ إِذَا كَانَ وَحْدَهُ وَ يُحِبُّ أَنْ يُحْمَدَ فِي جَمِيعِ أُمُورِهِ .
citation.translation: And by his chain, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There are three signs for the show-off – He is active when he sees the people (around him), and he is lazy when he is alone, and he loves to be praised in the entirety of his affairs’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/110)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Usman Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Salim who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Says: “I<sup>azwj</sup> am the best Associate. The one who associates someone else with Me<sup>azwj</sup> in a deed he does, I<sup>azwj</sup> will not Accept it except what was (done) for Me<sup>azwj</sup> purely’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَنَا خَيْرُ شَرِيكٍ مَنْ أَشْرَكَ مَعِي غَيْرِي فِي عَمَلٍ عَمِلَهُ لَمْ أَقْبَلْهُ إِلَّا مَا كَانَ لِي خَالِصاً .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Usman Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Salim who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Says: “I<sup>azwj</sup> am the best Associate. The one who associates someone else with Me<sup>azwj</sup> in a deed he does, I<sup>azwj</sup> will not Accept it except what was (done) for Me<sup>azwj</sup> purely’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/110)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Dawood, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who displays to the people what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Loves and opposes Allah<sup>azwj</sup> with what He<sup>azwj</sup> Dislikes (showoff), he will find Allah<sup>azwj</sup> at war with him’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: مَنْ أَظْهَرَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا يُحِبُّ اللَّهُ وَ بَارَزَ اللَّهَ بِمَا كَرِهَهُ لَقِيَ اللَّهَ وَ هُوَ مَاقِتٌ لَهُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Dawood, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who displays to the people what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Loves and opposes Allah<sup>azwj</sup> with what He<sup>azwj</sup> Dislikes (showoff), he will find Allah<sup>azwj</sup> at war with him’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مختلف فيه - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/111)

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Fazl Abu Al Abbas, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘What is one of you doing if he does a good deed in the apparent and does the evil deed in private. Does he not return it to his own self, so he knows that, that is not like that? And Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [75:14] But! The human being is evidence against himself. The secretive deeds, when it is correct, strengthens the deed done in the open’. Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Jamhour, from Fazalat, from Muawiya, from Al Fuzayl, from Abu Abdullahasws – similar to it.

citation.arabic_text: مَا يَصْنَعُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يُظْهِرَ حَسَناً وَ يُسِرَّ سَيِّئاً أَ لَيْسَ يَرْجِعُ إِلَى نَفْسِهِ فَيَعْلَمَ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ لَيْسَ كَذَلِكَ وَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَقُولُ بَلِ الْإِنْسانُ عَلى نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ إِنَّ السَّرِيرَةَ إِذَا صَحَّتْ قَوِيَتِ الْعَلَانِيَةُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُمْهُورٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) مِثْلَهُ .
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Fazl Abu Al Abbas, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘What is one of you doing if he does a good deed in the apparent and does the evil deed in private. text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Salih Bin Al Sindy, from Ja’far Bin Bashir, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is none from a servant who does a good deed secretly except that the days would not pass by until Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Manifests goodness to him; and there is none from a servant who does an evil deed secretly except that the days would not go by until Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Manifests the evil to him’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُسِرُّ خَيْراً إِلَّا لَمْ تَذْهَبِ الْأَيَّامُ حَتَّى يُظْهِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ خَيْراً وَ مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُسِرُّ شَرّاً إِلَّا لَمْ تَذْهَبِ الْأَيَّامُ حَتَّى يُظْهِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ شَرّاً .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Salih Bin Al Sindy, from Ja’far Bin Bashir, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is none from a servant who does a good deed secretly except that the days would not pass by until Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Manifests goodness to him; and there is none from a servant who does an evil deed secretly except that the days would not go by until Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Manifests the evil to him’.

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Yahya Bin Bashir, from his father, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who intends Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic with the little from his deeds, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Manifest a lot for him from what he intended; and the one who intends the people with the more from his deeds during the exhaustion from his body and staying awake from his night, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would Refuse except that He<sup>azwj</sup> Belittles it in the eyes of the ones whom he (intended to) hear him’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: مَنْ أَرَادَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِالْقَلِيلِ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ أَظْهَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا أَرَادَ وَ مَنْ أَرَادَ النَّاسَ بِالْكَثِيرِ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ فِي تَعَبٍ مِنْ بَدَنِهِ وَ سَهَرٍ مِنْ لَيْلِهِ أَبَى اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَّا أَنْ يُقَلِّلَهُ فِي عَيْنِ مَنْ سَمِعَهُ .

citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/112)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘There would be coming a time upon the people, their secretive matters would be wicked and they would be good in the public in greed regarding the world, not intending by it what is in the Presence of their Lord<sup>azwj</sup>. Their religion would happen to be show-off, the fear not blending in them. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Punish them generally. So they would be supplicating with the Supplication of the drowning one (Dua Al-Ghareek), but it would not be Answered for them’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) سَيَأْتِي عَلَى النَّاسِ زَمَانٌ تَخْبُثُ فِيهِ سَرَائِرُهُمْ وَ تَحْسُنُ فِيهِ عَلَانِيَتُهُمْ طَمَعاً فِي الدُّنْيَا لَا يُرِيدُونَ بِهِ مَا عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ يَكُونُ دِينُهُمْ رِيَاءً لَا يُخَالِطُهُمْ خَوْفٌ يَعُمُّهُمُ اللَّهُ بِعِقَابٍ فَيَدْعُونَهُ دُعَاءَ الْغَرِيقِ فَلَا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُمْ .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Umar Bin Yazeed who said, ‘I was having dinner with Abu Abdullahasws when he recited this Verse [75:14] But! The human being is evidence against himself [75:15] Although he puts forth his excuses. (Heasws said): ‘O Abu Hafs! What is the human doing if he apologises to the people with against what Allahazwj Knows from him. Rasool-Allahsaww was saying: ‘The one does something secretly, Allahazwj would Clothe it in return – if good, so good, and if evil, so evil’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: إِنِّي لَأَتَعَشَّى مَعَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِذْ تَلَا هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ بَلِ الْإِنْسانُ عَلى نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ وَ لَوْ أَلْقى مَعاذِيرَهُ يَا أَبَا حَفْصٍ مَا يَصْنَعُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنْ يَعْتَذِرَ إِلَى النَّاسِ بِخِلَافِ مَا يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) كَانَ يَقُولُ مَنْ أَسَرَّ سَرِيرَةً أَلْبَسَهُ اللَّهُ رِدَاءَهَا إِنْ خَيْراً فَخَيْرٌ وَ إِنْ شَرّاً فَشَرٌّ .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from one of his companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The remaining upon the deed is more difficult than the deed itself’. He said, ‘And what is the remaining upon the deed?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The man maintains relationships by helping (a relative) and he spends an expenditure for the Sake of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Alone, there being no associates for Him<sup>azwj</sup>, so a secretive good deed is Recorded for him. Then he mentions it and it gets Deleted, and an open good deed is Recorded for him. Then he mentions it (again), and a showing-off is Recorded for him’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: الْإِبْقَاءُ عَلَى الْعَمَلِ أَشَدُّ مِنَ الْعَمَلِ قَالَ وَ مَا الْإِبْقَاءُ عَلَى الْعَمَلِ قَالَ يَصِلُ الرَّجُلُ بِصِلَةٍ وَ يُنْفِقُ نَفَقَةً لِلَّهِ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ فَكُتِبَ لَهُ سِرّاً ثُمَّ يَذْكُرُهَا وَ تُمْحَى فَتُكْتَبُ لَهُ عَلَانِيَةً ثُمَّ يَذْكُرُهَا فَتُمْحَى وَ تُكْتَبُ لَهُ رِيَاءً .

citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/114)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Fear Allahazwj with a fear not with an excuse, and perform deeds for Allahazwj without any showing off and not to be heard of, for the one who does a deed for other than Allahazwj, Allahazwj would Allocate him to his deeds’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( صلوات الله عليه ) اخْشَوُا اللَّهَ خَشْيَةً لَيْسَتْ بِتَعْذِيرٍ وَ اعْمَلُوا لِلَّهِ فِي غَيْرِ رِيَاءٍ وَ لَا سُمْعَةٍ فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ عَمِلَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ وَكَلَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَى عَمَلِهِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Fear Allahazwj with a fear not with an excuse, and perform deeds for Allahazwj without any showing off and not to be heard of, for the one who does a deed for other than Allahazwj, Allahazwj would Allocate him to his deeds’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/115)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the man who does something from the good works. So a person sees him, and that cheers him up’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem. There is no one except that he loves it that the goodness be made apparent for him among the people, so long as he did not do that, for that’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:116
citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَعْمَلُ الشَّيْ‏ءَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ فَيَرَاهُ إِنْسَانٌ فَيَسُرُّهُ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لَا بَأْسَ مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا وَ هُوَ يُحِبُّ أَنْ يَظْهَرَ لَهُ فِي النَّاسِ الْخَيْرُ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ صَنَعَ ذَلِكَ لِذَلِكَ .

citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/116)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Moammar Bin Khallad, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>. A man was mentioned and he (the narrator) said, ‘He loves the leadership’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Two fierce wolves among the sheep separated from their shepherd are not more harmful than the leadership is in the Religion of the Muslim’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:117
citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُ يُحِبُّ الرِّئَاسَةَ فَقَالَ مَا ذِئْبَانِ ضَارِيَانِ فِي غَنَمٍ قَدْ تَفَرَّقَ رِعَاؤُهَا بِأَضَرَّ فِي دِينِ الْمُسْلِمِ مِنَ الرِّئَاسَةِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Moammar Bin Khallad, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>. A man was mentioned and he (the narrator) said, ‘He loves the leadership’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Two fierce wolves among the sheep separated from their shepherd are not more harmful than the leadership is in the Religion of the Muslim’.

text: From him, from Ahmad, from Saeed Bin Janah, from his brother Abu Aamir, from a man, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who seeks the leadership, is destroyed’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:117
citation.arabic_text: مَنْ طَلَبَ الرِّئَاسَةَ هَلَكَ .
citation.translation: From him, from Ahmad, from Saeed Bin Janah, from his brother Abu Aamir, from a man, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who seeks the leadership, is destroyed’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/123)

text: A number of our companinons, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Abdullah Bin Muskan who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Beware of those leaders who are assuming the leadership, for by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, no slipper would tap behind a man (i.e., have one follower) except that he would be destroyed and cause destruction (to him - the leader)’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:117
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ إِيَّاكُمْ وَ هَؤُلَاءِ الرُّؤَسَاءَ الَّذِينَ يَتَرَأَّسُونَ فَوَ اللَّهِ مَا خَفَقَتِ النِّعَالُ خَلْفَ رَجُلٍ إِلَّا هَلَكَ وَ أَهْلَكَ .
citation.translation: A number of our companinons, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Abdullah Bin Muskan who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Beware of those leaders who are assuming the leadership, for by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, no slipper would tap behind a man (i.e., have one follower) except that he would be destroyed and cause destruction (to him - the leader)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/123)

text: From him, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazie, and someone else, raising it, said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Accursed is the one who is a leader! Accursed is the one who intends with it! Accursed is the one who discusses to himself with it!’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:117
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) مَلْعُونٌ مَنْ تَرَأَّسَ مَلْعُونٌ مَنْ هَمَّ بِهَا مَلْعُونٌ مَنْ حَدَّثَ بِهَا نَفْسَهُ .
citation.translation: From him, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazie, and someone else, raising it, said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Accursed is the one who is a leader! Accursed is the one who intends with it! Accursed is the one who discusses to himself with it!’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرفوع - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/123)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hasan Bin Ayoub, from Abu Aqela Al Sayrafi who said, ‘Karram narrated to me from Abu Hamza Al Sumaly who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Beware of the leadership, and beware of following the heels of men!’ I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! As for the leadership, so I have recognised it, and as for following the heels of men, so there is no two-thirds of whatever there is in my hands except that it is from following the heels of men’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘This is not where you are going with it. Beware of establishing a man besides the Proof<sup>asws</sup>, so you ratify him with regards to everything what he says (blind following)’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:117
citation.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنَا كَرَّامٌ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ الثُّمَالِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِيَّاكَ وَ الرِّئَاسَةَ وَ إِيَّاكَ أَنْ تَطَأَ أَعْقَابَ الرِّجَالِ قَالَ قُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ أَمَّا الرِّئَاسَةُ فَقَدْ عَرَفْتُهَا وَ أَمَّا أَنْ أَطَأَ أَعْقَابَ الرِّجَالِ فَمَا ثُلُثَا مَا فِي يَدِي إِلَّا مِمَّا وَطِئْتُ أَعْقَابَ الرِّجَالِ فَقَالَ لِي لَيْسَ حَيْثُ تَذْهَبُ إِيَّاكَ أَنْ تَنْصِبَ رَجُلًا دُونَ الْحُجَّةِ فَتُصَدِّقَهُ فِي كُلِّ مَا قَالَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hasan Bin Ayoub, from Abu Aqela Al Sayrafi who said, ‘Karram narrated to me from Abu Hamza Al Sumaly who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Beware of the leadership, and beware of following the heels of men!’ I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! As for the leadership, so I have recognised it, and as for following the heels of men, so there is no two-thirds of whatever there is in my hands except that it is from following the heels of men’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘This is not where you are going with it. Beware of establishing a man besides the Proof<sup>asws</sup>, so you ratify him with regards to everything what he says (blind following)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/123)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Abu Al Rabie al Shamy, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said to me: ‘Woe be unto you, O Abu Al-Rabie! You should neither seek the leadership, nor become a wolf, nor devour the people by us<sup>asws</sup> so Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Impoverish you, and do not say regarding us<sup>asws</sup> what we<sup>asws</sup> are not saying regarding ourselves<sup>asws</sup>, for you would be made to pause and would inevitably be questioned. So if you were truthful, we<sup>asws</sup> would ratify you, and if you were a liar, we<sup>asws</sup> would belie you’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لِي وَيْحَكَ يَا أَبَا الرَّبِيعِ لَا تَطْلُبَنَّ الرِّئَاسَةَ وَ لَا تَكُنْ ذِئْباً وَ لَا تَأْكُلْ بِنَا النَّاسَ فَيُفْقِرَكَ اللَّهُ وَ لَا تَقُلْ فِينَا مَا لَا نَقُولُ فِي أَنْفُسِنَا فَإِنَّكَ مَوْقُوفٌ وَ مَسْئُولٌ لَا مَحَالَةَ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ صَادِقاً صَدَّقْنَاكَ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ كَاذِباً كَذَّبْنَاكَ .

text: A number or our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Ibn Mayyah, from his father who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The one who wants the leadership, is destroyed!’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:117
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ مَنْ أَرَادَ الرِّئَاسَةَ هَلَكَ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Al A’ala, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Do you view that I<sup>asws</sup> do not recognise your good ones from your evils ones? citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ أَ تَرَى لَا أَعْرِفُ خِيَارَكُمْ مِنْ شِرَارِكُمْ بَلَى وَ اللَّهِ وَ إِنَّ شِرَارَكُمْ مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُوطَأَ عَقِبُهُ إِنَّهُ لَا بُدَّ مِنْ كَذَّابٍ أَوْ عَاجِزِ الرَّأْيِ .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ismail Bin Jabir, from Yunus Bin Zabyan who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying: “Woe be unto those who are confusing the world by (using) the Religion, and woe be unto those who are killing those who are ordering with the fairness from the people, and woe be unto those who are causing the Momin among them to walk upon the dissimulation. Is it Meazwj they are deceiving or upon Meazwj they are being audacious? So it is by Meazwj that Iazwj Swear by, Iazwj shall Cause such strife to arrive to them which would leave the most forbearing of them as (completely) confused’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:118
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَقُولُ وَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ يَخْتِلُونَ الدُّنْيَا بِالدِّينِ وَ وَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ يَقْتُلُونَ الَّذِينَ يَأْمُرُونَ بِالْقِسْطِ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَ وَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ يَسِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنُ فِيهِمْ بِالتَّقِيَّةِ أَ بِي يَغْتَرُّونَ أَمْ عَلَيَّ يَجْتَرِءُونَ فَبِي حَلَفْتُ لَأُتِيحَنَّ لَهُمْ فِتْنَةً تَتْرُكُ الْحَلِيمَ مِنْهُمْ حَيْرَانَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ismail Bin Jabir, from Yunus Bin Zabyan who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying: “Woe be unto those who are confusing the world by (using) the Religion, and woe be unto those who are killing those who are ordering with the fairness from the people, and woe be unto those who are causing the Momin among them to walk upon the dissimulation. text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Yusuf Al Bazzaz, from Moalla Bin Khunays, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one with the most intense of regrets on the Day of Judgment would be the one who portrayed the justice, then acted without it’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:119
citation.arabic_text: فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَكُبْكِبُوا فِيها هُمْ وَ الْغاوُونَ قَالَ يَا أَبَا بَصِيرٍ هُمْ قَوْمٌ وَصَفُوا عَدْلًا بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ ثُمَّ خَالَفُوهُ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ali Bin Atiyya, from Khaseyma who said, ‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Deliver to our<sup>asws</sup> Shias that whatever is in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> cannot be attained except by deeds; and deliver to our<sup>asws</sup> Shias that the people with the utmost of regrets on the Day of Judgment would be the one who portrayed justice, then opposed it to something else’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:119
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لِي أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) أَبْلِغْ شِيعَتَنَا أَنَّهُ لَنْ يُنَالَ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا بِعَمَلٍ وَ أَبْلِغْ شِيعَتَنَا أَنَّ أَعْظَمَ النَّاسِ حَسْرَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَنْ وَصَفَ عَدْلًا ثُمَّ يُخَالِفُهُ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ali Bin Atiyya, from Khaseyma who said, ‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Deliver to our<sup>asws</sup> Shias that whatever is in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> cannot be attained except by deeds; and deliver to our<sup>asws</sup> Shias that the people with the utmost of regrets on the Day of Judgment would be the one who portrayed justice, then opposed it to something else’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Haroun Bin Muslim, from Mas’ada Bin Sadaqa, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Beware of the quarrelling and the disputing for these two create ill feelings towards the brothers (in Eman) and upon these two hypocrisy grows’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:120
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) إِيَّاكُمْ وَ الْمِرَاءَ وَ الْخُصُومَةَ فَإِنَّهُمَا يُمْرِضَانِ الْقُلُوبَ عَلَى الْإِخْوَانِ وَ يَنْبُتُ عَلَيْهِمَا النِّفَاقُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Haroun Bin Muslim, from Mas’ada Bin Sadaqa, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Beware of the quarrelling and the disputing for these two create ill feelings towards the brothers (in Eman) and upon these two hypocrisy grows’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/130)

text: And by his chain, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Three (things), the one who meets Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic with these would enter the Paradise from whichever Door he so desires to – The one whose manners are excellent, and he fears Allah<sup>azwj</sup> in private and the public, and neglecting the quarrelling and even if he was right’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:120
citation.arabic_text: وَ بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) ثَلَاثٌ مَنْ لَقِيَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِهِنَّ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أَيِّ بَابٍ شَاءَ مَنْ حَسُنَ خُلُقُهُ وَ خَشِيَ اللَّهَ فِي الْمَغِيبِ وَ الْمَحْضَرِ وَ تَرَكَ الْمِرَاءَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مُحِقّاً
citation.translation: And by his chain, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Three (things), the one who meets Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic with these would enter the Paradise from whichever Door he so desires to – The one whose manners are excellent, and he fears Allah<sup>azwj</sup> in private and the public, and neglecting the quarrelling and even if he was right’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/136)

text: And by his chain, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: Whoever targets Allah in a quarrel (fighting against Just) may go through quick transition (from truth to falsehood)’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:120
citation.arabic_text: وَ بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ مَنْ نَصَبَ اللَّهَ غَرَضاً لِلْخُصُومَاتِ أَوْشَكَ أَنْ يُكْثِرَ الِانْتِقَالَ .
citation.translation: And by his chain, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: Whoever targets Allah in a quarrel (fighting against Just) may go through quick transition (from truth to falsehood)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/137)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Salih Bin Al Sindy, from Ja’far Bin Bashir, from Ammar Bin Marwan who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not quarrel with a forbearing one nor with a foolish one, for the forbearing one would detest you and the foolish one would harm you’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:120
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) لَا تُمَارِيَنَّ حَلِيماً وَ لَا سَفِيهاً فَإِنَّ الْحَلِيمَ يَقْلِيكَ وَ السَّفِيهَ يُؤْذِيكَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Salih Bin Al Sindy, from Ja’far Bin Bashir, from Ammar Bin Marwan who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not quarrel with a forbearing one nor with a foolish one, for the forbearing one would detest you and the foolish one would harm you’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/138)

text: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Hassan Bin Atiyya, from Umar Bin Yazeed, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Almost every time Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> came to me, said: ‘O Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>! text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, and Ali Bin Muhammad, from Salih Bin Abu Hammad, altogether from Al Washha, from Ahmad Bin A’iz, from Abu Khadeeja, from Moalla Bin Khunays, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘A man said to the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! Teach me (something)’. He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Go and don’t be angry’. So the man said, ‘I have suffice with that’. So he went to his family and he found that there was a battle in between his people, and they had lined up in rows and wearing the weapons. So when he saw that, he (also) wore his weapon, then stood along with them. Then he remembered the words of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, ‘Don’t be angry’. So he threw down the weapon, then went walking over to the people who were the enemies of his people, and he said, ‘O you all! Whatever injuries were with you, or (if) a killing, or a strike in which there were no effects, so upon me is (the compensation for it) from my wealth. I shall fulfil it’. So the people said, ‘So whatever it was, so it is for you, (although) we are first for it with that than you are (i.e. we don’t want anything)’. He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘So the people reconciled and the hostility was gone’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:121
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَجُلٌ لِلنَّبِيِّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عَلِّمْنِي قَالَ اذْهَبْ وَ لَا تَغْضَبْ فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ قَدْ اكْتَفَيْتُ بِذَاكَ فَمَضَى إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فَإِذَا بَيْنَ قَوْمِهِ حَرْبٌ قَدْ قَامُوا صُفُوفاً وَ لَبِسُوا السِّلَاحَ فَلَمَّا رَأَى ذَلِكَ لَبِسَ سِلَاحَهُ ثُمَّ قَامَ مَعَهُمْ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ قَوْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) لَا تَغْضَبْ فَرَمَى السِّلَاحَ ثُمَّ جَاءَ يَمْشِي إِلَى الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَدُوُّ قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَا هَؤُلَاءِ مَا كَانَتْ لَكُمْ مِنْ جِرَاحَةٍ أَوْ قَتْلٍ أَوْ ضَرْبٍ لَيْسَ فِيهِ أَثَرٌ فَعَلَيَّ فِي مَالِي أَنَا أُوفِيكُمُوهُ فَقَالَ الْقَوْمُ فَمَا كَانَ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ نَحْنُ أَوْلَى بِذَلِكَ مِنْكُمْ قَالَ فَاصْطَلَحَ الْقَوْمُ وَ ذَهَبَ الْغَضَبُ .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Ib Raib, from Abu Hamza Al Sumaly, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘This anger is an ember from the Satan<sup>la</sup>, being inflamed in the head of the son of Adam<sup>as</sup>, and that one of you, when he gets angered, his eyes turn red, his veins puff up and Satan<sup>la</sup> enters in him. So when one of you fears that from himself, so let him hold on to the earth, for the filth of the Satan<sup>la</sup> would go away from him during that’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مَنْ كَفَّ نَفْسَهُ عَنْ أَعْرَاضِ النَّاسِ أَقَالَ اللَّهُ نَفْسَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَ مَنْ كَفَّ غَضَبَهُ عَنِ النَّاسِ كَفَّ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى عَنْهُ عَذَابَ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ .

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ibn Mahboub, from Dawood Al Raqqy who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Fear Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and some of you should not envy the others. From the Laws of Isa<sup>as</sup> Bin Maryam<sup>as</sup> was the travelling about in the city. So he<sup>as</sup> went out in one of his tours and with him<sup>as</sup> was a man from his<sup>as</sup> companions of a short stature, and he used to frequently accompany Isa<sup>as</sup>. So when Isa<sup>as</sup> ended up to the sea, he<sup>as</sup> said: ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’, with correct certainty from him<sup>as</sup>, and he<sup>as</sup> walked upon the back of the surface of the water. So the short man said when he looked at Isa<sup>as</sup> risking it, ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’ with correct certainty from him. So he walked upon the water and caught up with Isa<sup>as</sup>. Then self-conceitedness entered into himself, so he said (to himself), ‘This is Isa<sup>as</sup>, the Spirit of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, walking upon the water and I am walking upon the water. So what is his<sup>as</sup> merit over me?’ He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘So he sunk into the water, and he cried for help to Isa<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>. So he<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> grabbed him from the water and extracted him, then said to him: ‘What did you say, O Shortie!?’ He said, ‘I said, ‘This is Isa<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>, Spirit of Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, walking upon the water, and I am walking upon the water’, and the self-conceitedness entered me due to that’. So Isa<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> said to him: ‘You had placed yourself in other than the place which Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> had Placed you in, therefore Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Detested you upon what you said. So repent to Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic from what you said’. He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘So the man repented and returned to his status which Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> had Placed him in. Therefore, fear Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> and you should not envy each other’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:122
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَ لَا يَحْسُدْ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضاً إِنَّ عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ كَانَ مِنْ شَرَائِعِهِ السَّيْحُ فِي الْبِلَادِ فَخَرَجَ فِي بَعْضِ سَيْحِهِ وَ مَعَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ قَصِيرٌ وَ كَانَ كَثِيرَ اللُّزُومِ لِعِيسَى ( عليه السلام ) فَلَمَّا انْتَهَى عِيسَى إِلَى الْبَحْرِ قَالَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ بِصِحَّةِ يَقِينٍ مِنْهُ فَمَشَى عَلَى ظَهْرِ الْمَاءِ فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ الْقَصِيرُ حِينَ نَظَرَ إِلَى عِيسَى ( عليه السلام ) جَازَهُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ بِصِحَّةِ يَقِينٍ مِنْهُ فَمَشَى عَلَى الْمَاءِ وَ لَحِقَ بِعِيسَى ( عليه السلام ) فَدَخَلَهُ الْعُجْبُ بِنَفْسِهِ فَقَالَ هَذَا عِيسَى رُوحُ اللَّهِ يَمْشِي عَلَى الْمَاءِ وَ أَنَا أَمْشِي عَلَى الْمَاءِ فَمَا فَضْلُهُ عَلَيَّ قَالَ فَرُمِسَ فِي الْمَاءِ فَاسْتَغَاثَ بِعِيسَى فَتَنَاوَلَهُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ فَأَخْرَجَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ مَا قُلْتَ يَا قَصِيرُ قَالَ قُلْتُ هَذَا رُوحُ اللَّهِ يَمْشِي عَلَى الْمَاءِ وَ أَنَا أَمْشِي عَلَى الْمَاءِ فَدَخَلَنِي مِنْ ذَلِكَ عُجْبٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ عِيسَى لَقَدْ وَضَعْتَ نَفْسَكَ فِي غَيْرِ الْمَوْضِعِ الَّذِي وَضَعَكَ اللَّهُ فِيهِ فَمَقَتَكَ اللَّهُ عَلَى مَا قُلْتَ فَتُبْ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مِمَّا قُلْتَ قَالَ فَتَابَ الرَّجُلُ وَ عَادَ إِلَى مَرْتَبَتِهِ الَّتِي وَضَعَهُ اللَّهُ فِيهَا فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَ لَا يَحْسُدَنَّ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضاً .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ibn Mahboub, from Dawood Al Raqqy who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Fear Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and some of you should not envy the others. From the Laws of Isa<sup>as</sup> Bin Maryam<sup>as</sup> was the travelling about in the city. So he<sup>as</sup> went out in one of his tours and with him<sup>as</sup> was a man from his<sup>as</sup> companions of a short stature, and he used to frequently accompany Isa<sup>as</sup>. So when Isa<sup>as</sup> ended up to the sea, he<sup>as</sup> said: ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’, with correct certainty from him<sup>as</sup>, and he<sup>as</sup> walked upon the back of the surface of the water. So the short man said when he looked at Isa<sup>as</sup> risking it, ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’ with correct certainty from him. So he walked upon the water and caught up with Isa<sup>as</sup>. Then self-conceitedness entered into himself, so he said (to himself), ‘This is Isa<sup>as</sup>, the Spirit of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, walking upon the water and I am walking upon the water. So what is his<sup>as</sup> merit over me?’ He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘So he sunk into the water, and he cried for help to Isa<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>. So he<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> grabbed him from the water and extracted him, then said to him: ‘What did you say, O Shortie!?’ He said, ‘I said, ‘This is Isa<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>, Spirit of Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, walking upon the water, and I am walking upon the water’, and the self-conceitedness entered me due to that’. So Isa<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> said to him: ‘You had placed yourself in other than the place which Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> had Placed you in, therefore Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Detested you upon what you said. So repent to Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic from what you said’. He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘So the man repented and returned to his status which Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> had Placed him in. Therefore, fear Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> and you should not envy each other’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مختلف فيه وصحته أقو ى - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/163)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The poverty can almost cause one to be a disbeliever, and the envy may almost overcome (disable) the power of an envying person’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Ali Bin Muhammad Al Qanasy, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad, from Minqary, from Abdul Razzaq, from Moamar, from Al Zuhry who said, ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> was asked about the prejudice, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The prejudice upon which its doer would be sinning is that he sees the evil man of his people as better than the good ones of other people, and it is not from the prejudice if he were to love the man of his people, but from the prejudice is that he assists his people upon the injustice’.

citation.arabic_text: سُئِلَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنِ الْعَصَبِيَّةِ فَقَالَ الْعَصَبِيَّةُ الَّتِي يَأْثَمُ عَلَيْهَا صَاحِبُهَا أَنْ يَرَى الرَّجُلُ شِرَارَ قَوْمِهِ خَيْراً مِنْ خِيَارِ قَوْمٍ آخَرِينَ وَ لَيْسَ مِنَ الْعَصَبِيَّةِ أَنْ يُحِبُّ الرَّجُلُ قَوْمَهُ وَ لَكِنْ مِنَ الْعَصَبِيَّةِ أَنْ يُعِينَ قَوْمَهُ عَلَى الظُّلْمِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Ali Bin Muhammad Al Qanasy, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad, from Minqary, from Abdul Razzaq, from Moamar, from Al Zuhry who said, ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> was asked about the prejudice, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The prejudice upon which its doer would be sinning is that he sees the evil man of his people as better than the good ones of other people, and it is not from the prejudice if he were to love the man of his people, but from the prejudice is that he assists his people upon the injustice’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/181)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Aban, from Hukeym who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the least of atheism (disbelief). So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The arrogance is the lowest of it’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:124
citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ أَدْنَى الْإِلْحَادِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ الْكِبْرَ أَدْنَاهُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Aban, from Hukeym who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the least of atheism (disbelief). So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The arrogance is the lowest of it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/182)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al Husayn Bin Abu Al A’ala, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The arrogance has happened to be in the evil people from every race, and the Pride is a Gown of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. So whoever disputes with Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic about His<sup>azwj</sup> Gown, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would not Increase him in except for the lowliness. Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> passed by one of the streets of Al-Medina and a black lady was scooping up the manure. So it was said to her, ‘Move aside from the way of Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup>!’ So she said, ‘The road is open (wide enough)’. So, some of the people thought of grabbing her (and pushing her aside). So Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> said: ‘Leave her, for she is tyrannial’ (bully).

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:124
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ الْكِبْرُ قَدْ يَكُونُ فِي شِرَارِ النَّاسِ مِنْ كُلِّ جِنْسٍ وَ الْكِبْرُ رِدَاءُ اللَّهِ فَمَنْ نَازَعَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ رِدَاءَهُ لَمْ يَزِدْهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا سَفَالًا إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مَرَّ فِي بَعْضِ طُرُقِ الْمَدِينَةِ وَ سَوْدَاءُ تَلْقُطُ السِّرْقِينَ فَقِيلَ لَهَا تَنَحَّيْ عَنْ طَرِيقِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ الطَّرِيقَ لَمُعْرَضٌ فَهَمَّ بِهَا بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ أَنْ يَتَنَاوَلَهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) دَعُوهَا فَإِنَّهَا جَبَّارَةٌ .

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Usman Bin Isa, from Al A’ala Bin Al Fuzayl, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Honour is a Gown of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and the Pride is His<sup>azwj</sup> Garment. So whoever holds onto any of these, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Fling him into Hell’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:124
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) الْعِزُّ رِدَاءُ اللَّهِ وَ الْكِبْرُ إِزَارُهُ فَمَنْ تَنَاوَلَ شَيْئاً مِنْهُ أَكَبَّهُ اللَّهُ فِي جَهَنَّمَ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Usman Bin Isa, from Al A’ala Bin Al Fuzayl, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Honour is a Gown of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and the Pride is His<sup>azwj</sup> Garment. text: From him, from his father, from Al Qasim Bin Urwa, from Abdullah Bin Bukeyr, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> both having said: ‘He would not enter the Paradise, the one in whose heart is particle’s weight of arrogance’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:124
citation.arabic_text: ا لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مَنْ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ مِنْ كِبْرٍ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Abu Ayoub, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from one of the two (5th or 6th Imamasws) having said: ‘He would not enter the Paradise, the one in whose heart there was the weight of a mustard seed from the arrogance’. He (the narrator) said, ‘So I said, ‘We are from Allahazwj and to Himazwj we are returning’. So heasws said: ‘What is the matter with you saying ‘We are from Allahazwj and to Himazwj we are returning’?’ I said, ‘Due to what I heard from youasws’. So heasws said: ‘It is not where you are going (understanding it). But rather, Iasws mean the rejection (of Wilayah). But rather it (arrogance) is the rejection (of Wilayah)’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:124
citation.arabic_text: لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ مِنَ الْكِبْرِ قَالَ فَاسْتَرْجَعْتُ فَقَالَ مَا لَكَ تَسْتَرْجِعُ قُلْتُ لِمَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْكَ فَقَالَ لَيْسَ حَيْثُ تَذْهَبُ إِنَّمَا أَعْنِي الْجُحُودَ إِنَّمَا هُوَ الْجُحُودُ .

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali Bin Uqba, from Ayoub Bin Al Hurr, from Abdul A’ala, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The arrogance is that you belittle the people and consider the Truth as foolish’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:124
citation.arabic_text: الْكِبْرُ أَنْ تَغْمِصَ النَّاسَ وَ تَسْفَهَ الْحَقَّ .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Abdul Al’ala Bin Ayn who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The greatest of the arrogance is belittling the people and considering the Truth as foolish’. I said, ‘And what (constitutes) belittling the people and considering the Truth as foolish?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘Ignoring the Truth and maligning upon its people. So the one who does that, so he has snatched from Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, His<sup>azwj</sup> Gown (of Pride)’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:124
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِنَّ أَعْظَمَ الْكِبْرِ غَمْصُ الْخَلْقِ وَ سَفَهُ الْحَقِّ قَالَ قُلْتُ وَ مَا غَمْصُ الْخَلْقِ وَ سَفَهُ الْحَقِّ قَالَ يَجْهَلُ الْحَقَّ وَ يَطْعُنُ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ فَمَنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ نَازَعَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ رِدَاءَهُ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibn Bukeyr, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘In Hell there is a valley for the arrogant ones called Saqar. It complained to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic of the intensity of its own heat, and asked Him<sup>azwj</sup> that He<sup>azwj</sup> Permits for it to breathe. So it exhaled and it burnt down the Hell’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:124
citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ فِي جَهَنَّمَ لَوَادِياً لِلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ يُقَالُ لَهُ سَقَرُ شَكَا إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ شِدَّةَ حَرِّهِ وَ سَأَلَهُ أَنْ يَأْذَنَ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَنَفَّسَ فَتَنَفَّسَ فَأَحْرَقَ جَهَنَّمَ .

citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن موثق كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/210)

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:124
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ إِنَّ الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ يُجْعَلُونَ فِي صُوَرِ الذَّرِّ يَتَوَطَّأُهُمُ النَّاسُ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الْحِسَابِ .

citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/211)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from someone else, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from his uncle Yaqoub Bin Salim, from Abdul A’ala, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What is the arrogance?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The greatest of the arrogance is that you consider the Truth as foolish and you belittle the people (of Truth)’. I said, ‘And what is considering the Truth as foolish?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Ignoring the Truth and his criticizing the people of Truth’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:124
citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لَهُ مَا الْكِبْرُ فَقَالَ أَعْظَمُ الْكِبْرِ أَنْ تَسْفَهَ الْحَقَّ وَ تَغْمِصَ النَّاسَ قُلْتُ وَ مَا سَفَهُ الْحَقِّ قَالَ يَجْهَلُ الْحَقَّ وَ يَطْعُنُ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from someone else, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from his uncle Yaqoub Bin Salim, from Abdul A’ala, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What is the arrogance?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The greatest of the arrogance is that you consider the Truth as foolish and you belittle the people (of Truth)’.
