citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَوْحَى إِلَى نَبِيٍّ مِنْ أَنْبِيَائِهِ فِي مَمْلَكَةِ جَبَّارٍ مِنَ الْجَبَّارِينَ أَنِ ائْتِ هَذَا الْجَبَّارَ فَقُلْ لَهُ إِنَّنِي لَمْ أَسْتَعْمِلْكَ عَلَى سَفْكِ الدِّمَاءِ وَ اتِّخَاذِ الْأَمْوَالِ وَ إِنَّمَا اسْتَعْمَلْتُكَ لِتَكُفَّ عَنِّي أَصْوَاتَ الْمَظْلُومِينَ فَإِنِّي لَمْ أَدَعْ ظُلَامَتَهُمْ وَ إِنْ كَانُوا كُفَّاراً .
citation.translation: From him, from Ibn Mahboub, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Revealed upon a Prophet<sup>as</sup> from His<sup>azwj</sup> Prophets<sup>as</sup> in a kingdom of a tyrant from the tyrants: “Go to this tyrant, so say to him, ‘I<sup>azwj</sup> did not Utilise you upon shedding the blood and seizing the wealth, and rather I<sup>azwj</sup> Utilised you to restrain from Me<sup>azwj</sup> the voices of the oppressed, for I<sup>azwj</sup> will not Leave their injustices (Unpunished), and even though they (the oppressed) may be disbelievers’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/303)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washha, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying, ‘The one who consumes the wealth of his brother unjustly and does not return it to him would eat an ember of Fire on the Day of Judgement’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:136
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ مَنْ أَكَلَ مَالَ أَخِيهِ ظُلْماً وَ لَمْ يَرُدَّهُ إِلَيْهِ أَكَلَ جَذْوَةً مِنَ النَّارِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washha, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying, ‘The one who consumes the wealth of his brother unjustly and does not return it to him would eat an ember of Fire on the Day of Judgement’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/304)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Talha Bin Zayd, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who acts with injustice, and the one who supports him, and the one who is pleased (agrees) with him are associates, all three of them’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:136
citation.arabic_text: الْعَامِلُ بِالظُّلْمِ وَ الْمُعِينُ لَهُ وَ الرَّاضِي بِهِ شُرَكَاءُ ثَلَاثَتُهُمْ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Talha Bin Zayd, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who acts with injustice, and the one who supports him, and the one who is pleased (agrees) with him are associates, all three of them’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف كالموثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/305)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Hisham Bin Salim who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The servant who happens to be oppressed, so he does not cease to supplicate until he (himself) becomes unjust’ (for excessively supplicating against him).

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:136
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ لَيَكُونُ مَظْلُوماً فَمَا يَزَالُ يَدْعُو حَتَّى يَكُونَ ظَالِماً .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Hisham Bin Salim who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The servant who happens to be oppressed, so he does not cease to supplicate until he (himself) becomes unjust’ (for excessively supplicating against him).
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/305)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Abu Nahshal, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Whoever gives justification for an unjust one of his injustice, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Cause him to be overcome by the one who would oppress him, so if he supplicates, it would not be Answered for him, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will not Recompense him upon his being oppressed’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:136
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ مَنْ عَذَرَ ظَالِماً بِظُلْمِهِ سَلَّطَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ مَنْ يَظْلِمُهُ فَإِنْ دَعَا لَمْ يَسْتَجِبْ لَهُ وَ لَمْ يَأْجُرْهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى ظُلَامَتِهِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Abu Nahshal, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Whoever gives justification for an unjust one of his injustice, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Cause him to be overcome by the one who would oppress him, so if he supplicates, it would not be Answered for him, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will not Recompense him upon his being oppressed’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/306)

text: From him, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘Allahazwj does not Cause an oppressor to be conquered except by an oppressor, and these are the Words of the Mighty and Majestic [6:129] And thus do We make some of the unjust to befriend others’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:136
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ مَا انْتَصَرَ اللَّهُ مِنْ ظَالِمٍ إِلَّا بِظَالِمٍ وَ ذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ كَذلِكَ نُوَلِّي بَعْضَ الظَّالِمِينَ بَعْضاً .
citation.translation: From him, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘Allahazwj does not Cause an oppressor to be conquered except by an oppressor, and these are the Words of the Mighty and Majestic [6:129] And thus do We make some of the unjust to befriend others’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/307)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who is unjust to anyone, so he dies, then let him seek Forgiveness of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> for him, for it would be an expiation for him (for having been unjust)’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:136
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مَنْ ظَلَمَ أَحَداً فَفَاتَهُ فَلْيَسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ لَهُ فَإِنَّهُ كَفَّارَةٌ لَهُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who is unjust to anyone, so he dies, then let him seek Forgiveness of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> for him, for it would be an expiation for him (for having been unjust)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/308)

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad Al Kufi, from Ibrahim Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Khalaf, from Musa Bin Ibrahim Al Marouzy, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> said: ‘The one who wakes up in the morning and he does not think of being unjust to anyone, Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> would Forigve him what he had sinned’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:136
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مَنْ أَصْبَحَ وَ هُوَ لَا يَهُمُّ بِظُلْمِ أَحَدٍ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ مَا اجْتَرَمَ .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Muhammad Al Kufi, from Ibrahim Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Khalaf, from Musa Bin Ibrahim Al Marouzy, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> said: ‘The one who wakes up in the morning and he does not think of being unjust to anyone, Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> would Forigve him what he had sinned’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/308)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘Two men came over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding management issues and dealings between the two of them. So when he<sup>asws</sup> heard both their speeches, said: ‘But no one would achieve success with goodness from a success achieved by the injustice. But, the oppressed one takes from the Religion of the unjust one more than what the unjust one takes from the wealth of the oppressed one’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who does evil with the people should not deny the evil when it is done with him. But he, the son of Adam<sup>as</sup>, rather tends to reap what he sows, and no one has harvested sweetness from the bitterness, nor a bitterness from the sweetness’. So the two men reconciled before they arose’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:136
citation.arabic_text: دَخَلَ رَجُلَانِ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فِي مُدَارَاةٍ بَيْنَهُمَا وَ مُعَامَلَةٍ فَلَمَّا أَنْ سَمِعَ كَلَامَهُمَا قَالَ أَمَا إِنَّهُ مَا ظَفِرَ أَحَدٌ بِخَيْرٍ مِنْ ظَفَرٍ بِالظُّلْمِ أَمَا إِنَّ الْمَظْلُومَ يَأْخُذُ مِنْ دِينِ الظَّالِمِ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا يَأْخُذُ الظَّالِمُ مِنْ مَالِ الْمَظْلُومِ ثُمَّ قَالَ مَنْ يَفْعَلِ الشَّرَّ بِالنَّاسِ فَلَا نْيُكِرِ الشَّرَّ إِذَا فُعِلَ بِهِ أَمَا إِنَّهُ إِنَّمَا يَحْصُدُ ابْنُ آدَمَ مَا يَزْرَعُ وَ لَيْسَ يَحْصِدُ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْمُرِّ حُلْواً وَ لَا مِنَ الْحُلْوِ مُرّاً فَاصْطَلَحَ الرَّجُلَانِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُومَا .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘Two men came over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding management issues and dealings between the two of them. So when he<sup>asws</sup> heard both their speeches, said: ‘But no one would achieve success with goodness from a success achieved by the injustice. But, the oppressed one takes from the Religion of the unjust one more than what the unjust one takes from the wealth of the oppressed one’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who does evil with the people should not deny the evil when it is done with him. But he, the son of Adam<sup>as</sup>, rather tends to reap what he sows, and no one has harvested sweetness from the bitterness, nor a bitterness from the sweetness’. So the two men reconciled before they arose’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/309)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who fears the retaliation should refrain from oppressing the people’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:136
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مَنْ خَافَ الْقِصَاصَ كَفَّ عَنْ ظُلْمِ النَّاسِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who fears the retaliation should refrain from oppressing the people’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/310)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Muhammad Al Wabishi who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Be cautious of your personal desires just as you are being cautious of your enemies, for there is nothing more inimical to the men than their following of their own personal desires and the harvest of their tongues’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:137
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ احْذَرُوا أَهْوَاءَكُمْ كَمَا تَحْذَرُونَ أَعْدَاءَكُمْ فَلَيْسَ شَيْ‏ءٌ أَعْدَى لِلرِّجَالِ مِنِ اتِّبَاعِ أَهْوَائِهِمْ وَ حَصَائِدِ أَلْسِنَتِهِمْ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Muhammad Al Wabishi who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Be cautious of your personal desires just as you are being cautious of your enemies, for there is nothing more inimical to the men than their following of their own personal desires and the harvest of their tongues’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/310)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Qasim, from Abu Hamza, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is Saying: “By My<sup>azwj</sup> Honour, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Majesty, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Magnificence, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Greatness, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Light, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Exaltedness, and the Loftiness of My<sup>azwj</sup> Position! A servant would not prefer his own personal desires over My<sup>azwj</sup> Desires except that I<sup>azwj</sup> will Scatter his affairs over him and Clothe his world upon him, and pre-occupy his heart with it, and would not Give him from it except what I<sup>azwj</sup> have Ordained for him. And by My<sup>azwj</sup> Honour, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Majesty, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Magnificence, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Light, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Exaltedness, and the Loftiness of My<sup>azwj</sup> Position! No servant would prefer My<sup>azwj</sup> Desires above his own personal desires except that I<sup>azwj</sup> Make My<sup>azwj</sup> Angels to guard him, and the skies and the earth would guarantee his sustenance, and I<sup>saww</sup> would Back him from behind every trade with every trader, and the world would come to him and it (world) would be subdued’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:137
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) يَقُولُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ عِزَّتِي وَ جَلَالِي وَ عَظَمَتِي وَ كِبْرِيَائِي وَ نُورِي وَ عُلُوِّي وَ ارْتِفَاعِ مَكَانِي لَا يُؤْثِرُ عَبْدٌ هَوَاهُ عَلَى هَوَايَ إِلَّا شَتَّتُّ عَلَيْهِ أَمْرَهُ وَ لَبَّسْتُ عَلَيْهِ دُنْيَاهُ وَ شَغَلْتُ قَلْبَهُ بِهَا وَ لَمْ أُؤْتِهِ مِنْهَا إِلَّا مَا قَدَّرْتُ لَهُ وَ عِزَّتِي وَ جَلَالِي وَ عَظَمَتِي وَ نُورِي وَ عُلُوِّي وَ ارْتِفَاعِ مَكَانِي لَا يُؤْثِرُ عَبْدٌ هَوَايَ عَلَى هَوَاهُ إِلَّا اسْتَحْفَظْتُهُ مَلَائِكَتِي وَ كَفَّلْتُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرَضِينَ رِزْقَهُ وَ كُنْتُ لَهُ مِنْ وَرَاءِ تِجَارَةِ كُلِّ تَاجِرٍ وَ أَتَتْهُ الدُّنْيَا وَ هِيَ رَاغِمَةٌ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Qasim, from Abu Hamza, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is Saying: “By My<sup>azwj</sup> Honour, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Majesty, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Magnificence, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Greatness, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Light, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Exaltedness, and the Loftiness of My<sup>azwj</sup> Position! A servant would not prefer his own personal desires over My<sup>azwj</sup> Desires except that I<sup>azwj</sup> will Scatter his affairs over him and Clothe his world upon him, and pre-occupy his heart with it, and would not Give him from it except what I<sup>azwj</sup> have Ordained for him. And by My<sup>azwj</sup> Honour, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Majesty, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Magnificence, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Light, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Exaltedness, and the Loftiness of My<sup>azwj</sup> Position! No servant would prefer My<sup>azwj</sup> Desires above his own personal desires except that I<sup>azwj</sup> Make My<sup>azwj</sup> Angels to guard him, and the skies and the earth would guarantee his sustenance, and I<sup>saww</sup> would Back him from behind every trade with every trader, and the world would come to him and it (world) would be subdued’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/313)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Abu Hamza, from Yahya Bin Uqeyl who said, ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘But rather, Iasws fear two (things) upon you – following of personal desires and long-term works. As for following the personal desires, so it blocks from the truth, and as for the long-term works, so it makes you forget the Hereafter’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:137
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) إِنَّمَا أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمُ اثْنَتَيْنِ اتِّبَاعَ الْهَوَى وَ طُولَ الْأَمَلِ أَمَّا اتِّبَاعُ الْهَوَى فَإِنَّهُ يَصُدُّ عَنِ الْحَقِّ وَ أَمَّا طُولُ الْأَمَلِ فَيُنْسِي الْآخِرَةَ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Abu Hamza, from Yahya Bin Uqeyl who said, ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘But rather, Iasws fear two (things) upon you – following of personal desires and long-term works. As for following the personal desires, so it blocks from the truth, and as for the long-term works, so it makes you forget the Hereafter’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/316)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman Al Asammi, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Fear the easy climb up when there was a bumpy slope down’. He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘And Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> was saying: ‘Do not leave the soul and its desires unguarded; its desires are to destroy it. Leaving the soul with its desires unguarded is hurting the soul, however, guarding the soul against its desires is medicine for its illness’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:137
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لِي أَبُو الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) اتَّقِ الْمُرْتَقَى السَّهْلَ إِذَا كَانَ مُنْحَدَرُهُ وَعْراً قَالَ وَ كَانَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ لَا تَدَعِ النَّفْسَ وَ هَوَاهَا فَإِنَّ هَوَاهَا فِي رَدَاهَا وَ تَرْكُ النَّفْسِ وَ مَا تَهْوَى أَذَاهَا وَ كَفُّ النَّفْسِ عَمَّا تَهْوَى دَوَاهَا .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman Al Asammi, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Fear the easy climb up when there was a bumpy slope down’. He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘And Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> was saying: ‘Do not leave the soul and its desires unguarded; its desires are to destroy it. Leaving the soul with its desires unguarded is hurting the soul, however, guarding the soul against its desires is medicine for its illness’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/316)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, raising it who said, ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Had it not been that the plotting and the deception would be in the Fire, Iasws would have been the most skilful in evil planning’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:138
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) لَوْ لَا أَنَّ الْمَكْرَ وَ الْخَدِيعَةَ فِي النَّارِ لَكُنْتُ أَمْكَرَ النَّاسِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, raising it who said, ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Had it not been that the plotting and the deception would be in the Fire, Iasws would have been the most skilful in evil planning’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرفوع كالحسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/318)

text: Ali, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Every treacherous one would come on the Day of Judgment with an imam (leader), with a lopsided mouth until he enters the Fire; and every breaker of the allegiance to an Imam<sup>asws</sup> would come as a leper (mutilated) until he enters the Fire’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:138
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) يَجِي‏ءُ كُلُّ غَادِرٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِإِمَامٍ مَائِلٍ شِدْقُهُ حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ النَّارَ وَ يَجِي‏ءُ كُلُّ نَاكِثٍ بَيْعَةَ إِمَامٍ أَجْذَمَ حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ النَّارَ .

citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/320)

text: From him, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘He is not from us<sup>saww</sup> the one who plots against a Muslim’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:138
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ مَاكَرَ مُسْلِماً .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Talha Bin Zayd, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about two towns from the people of war, for each of them being a king upon a border. They fought then they reconciled. Then one of the two kings betrayed his companion, so he came over to the Muslims and reconciled with them upon that he would carry out a military expedition along with them for that city (of the other king)’. So Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘It is not befitting for the Muslims that they should be treacherous, nor should they be instructing others with the treachery, nor should they be fighting alongside those who are treacherous. But, they should be fighting against the Polytheists wherever they find them, nor is it allowed upon them what the disbelievers pact upon them’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:138
citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَرْيَتَيْنِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْحَرْبِ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا مَلِكٌ عَلَى حِدَةٍ اقْتَتَلُوا ثُمَّ اصْطَلَحُوا ثُمَّ إِنَّ أَحَدَ الْمَلِكَيْنِ غَدَرَ بِصَاحِبِهِ فَجَاءَ إِلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَصَالَحَهُمْ عَلَى أَنْ يَغْزُوَ مَعَهُمْ تِلْكَ الْمَدِينَةَ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) لَا يَنْبَغِي لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ أَنْ يَغْدِرُوا وَ لَا يَأْمُرُوا بِالْغَدْرِ وَ لَا يُقَاتِلُوا مَعَ الَّذِينَ غَدَرُوا وَ لَكِنَّهُمْ يُقَاتِلُونَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ حَيْثُ وَجَدُوهُمْ وَ لَا يَجُوزُ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا عَاهَدَ عَلَيْهِ الْكُفَّارُ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Talha Bin Zayd, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about two towns from the people of war, for each of them being a king upon a border. They fought then they reconciled. Then one of the two kings betrayed his companion, so he came over to the Muslims and reconciled with them upon that he would carry out a military expedition along with them for that city (of the other king)’. citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف كالموثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/322)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun, from Abdullah Bin Amro Bin Al Ash’as, from Abdullah Bin Hammad Al Ansary, from Yahya Bin Abdullah Bin Al Hassan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Every treacherous one would come with an imam on the Day of Judgment, with a lopsided mouth until he enters the Fire’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:138

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from his uncle Yaqoub Bin Salim, from Abu Al Hassan Al Abady, from Sa’d Bin Tareyf, from Al Asbagh Bin Nubata who said, ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said one day, and heasws was addressing upon the Pulpit at Al-Kufa: ‘O you people! Had it not been for myasws abhorrence of the treachery, Iasws would have been the craftiest of the people. Indeed! For every treachery there is an immorality, and for every immorality there is disbelief. Indeed! And the treachery, and the immorality, and the betrayal would be in the Fire’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:138
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ وَ هُوَ يَخْطُبُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ بِالْكُوفَةِ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ لَوْ لَا كَرَاهِيَةُ الْغَدْرِ كُنْتُ مِنْ أَدْهَى النَّاسِ أَلَا إِنَّ لِكُلِّ غُدَرَةٍ فُجَرَةً وَ لِكُلِّ فُجَرَةٍ كُفَرَةً أَلَا وَ إِنَّ الْغَدْرَ وَ الْفُجُورَ وَ الْخِيَانَةَ فِي النَّارِ.
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from his uncle Yaqoub Bin Salim, from Abu Al Hassan Al Abady, from Sa’d Bin Tareyf, from Al Asbagh Bin Nubata who said, ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said one day, and heasws was addressing upon the Pulpit at Al-Kufa: ‘O you people! text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, from Abu Al Nu’man who said, ‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Abu Al-Nu’man! Do not lie against us<sup>asws</sup> (or) your true Religion would be Confiscated, and do not seek to become a leader for it would happen to be a sin, and do not devour (earn from) the people through us<sup>asws</sup>, for you would be poor, for you would be Paused inevitably and Questioned. So if you were truthful we<sup>asws</sup> would ratify you, and if you lie, we<sup>asws</sup> would belie you’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:139
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) يَا أَبَا النُّعْمَانِ لَا تَكْذِبْ عَلَيْنَا كَذِبَةً فَتُسْلَبَ الْحَنِيفِيَّةَ وَ لَا تَطْلُبَنَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ رَأْساً فَتَكُونَ ذَنَباً وَ لَا تَسْتَأْكِلِ النَّاسَ بِنَا فَتَفْتَقِرَ فَإِنَّكَ مَوْقُوفٌ لَا مَحَالَةَ وَ مَسْئُولٌ فَإِنْ صَدَقْتَ صَدَّقْنَاكَ وَ إِنْ كَذَبْتَ كَذَّبْنَاكَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, from Abu Al Nu’man who said, ‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Abu Al-Nu’man! Do not lie against us<sup>asws</sup> (or) your true Religion would be Confiscated, and do not seek to become a leader for it would happen to be a sin, and do not devour (earn from) the people through us<sup>asws</sup>, for you would be poor, for you would be Paused inevitably and Questioned. So if you were truthful we<sup>asws</sup> would ratify you, and if you lie, we<sup>asws</sup> would belie you’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/325)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from the one who narrated it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> was saying to his<sup>asws</sup> children: ‘Fear the lies, the small ones from it and the big ones during every serious and laughable matters, for the man, when he lies during the small (matter) becomes audacious upon the big (lies). Do you not know that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘(So long as) the servant does not cease to speak the truth until Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Writes him as a truthful, and (so long as) the servant does not cease to lie until Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Writes him as a liar’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:139
citation.arabic_text: كَانَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ ( صلوات الله عليه ) يَقُولُ لِوُلْدِهِ اتَّقُوا الْكَذِبَ الصَّغِيرَ مِنْهُ وَ الْكَبِيرَ فِي كُلِّ جِدٍّ وَ هَزْلٍ فَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ إِذَا كَذَبَ فِي الصَّغِيرِ اجْتَرَى عَلَى الْكَبِيرِ أَ مَا عَلِمْتُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) قَالَ مَا يَزَالُ الْعَبْدُ يَصْدُقُ حَتَّى يَكْتُبَهُ اللَّهُ صِدِّيقاً وَ مَا يَزَالُ الْعَبْدُ يَكْذِبُ حَتَّى يَكْتُبَهُ اللَّهُ كَذَّاباً .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from the one who narrated it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> was saying to his<sup>asws</sup> children: ‘Fear the lies, the small ones from it and the big ones during every serious and laughable matters, for the man, when he lies during the small (matter) becomes audacious upon the big (lies). Do you not know that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘(So long as) the servant does not cease to speak the truth until Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Writes him as a truthful, and (so long as) the servant does not cease to lie until Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Writes him as a liar’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/327)

text: From him, from Usman Bin Isa, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic made locks to be for the evil, and Made keys to be for those locks being the (intoxicating) drink, and the lying is more evil than the (intoxicating) drink’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:139
citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ جَعَلَ لِلشَّرِّ أَقْفَالًا وَ جَعَلَ مَفَاتِيحَ تِلْكَ الْأَقْفَالِ الشَّرَابَ وَ الْكَذِبُ شَرٌّ مِنَ الشَّرَابِ .
citation.translation: From him, from Usman Bin Isa, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic made locks to be for the evil, and Made keys to be for those locks being the (intoxicating) drink, and the lying is more evil than the (intoxicating) drink’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/329)

text: From him, from his father, from the one who mentioned it, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Layli, from his father, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘The lie, it is the ruination of the Emān’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:139
citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ الْكَذِبَ هُوَ خَرَابُ الْإِيمَانِ .
citation.translation: From him, from his father, from the one who mentioned it, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Layli, from his father, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘The lie, it is the ruination of the Emān’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/329)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad and Ali Bin Muhammad, from Salih Bin Abu Hammad, altogether from Al Washha, from Ahmad Bin A’iz, from Abu Khadeeja, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The lying upon Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and upon His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup> is from the major sins’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:139

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Al Qasim Bin Urwa, from Abdul Hameed Al Ta’iy, from Al Asbagh Bin Nubata who said, ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘A servant cannot find the taste of the Emān until he leaves the lies, its vain ones and its serious ones’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:139
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) لَا يَجِدُ عَبْدٌ طَعْمَ الْإِيمَانِ حَتَّى يَتْرُكَ الْكَذِبَ هَزْلَهُ وَ جِدَّهُ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The liar, he is the one who lies regarding something?’ There is no one except that would happen from him, but (it is the) one with the tendency for the lying’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:139
citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) الْكَذَّابُ هُوَ الَّذِي يَكْذِبُ فِي الشَّيْ‏ءِ قَالَ لَا مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا يَكُونُ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ وَ لَكِنَّ الْمَطْبُوعَ عَلَى الْكَذِبِ .

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Al Hassan Bin Zareyf, from his father, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Isa<sup>as</sup> Bin Maryam<sup>as</sup>: ‘The one who frequently lies, his radiance goes away’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:139
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ ( عليه السلام ) مَنْ كَثُرَ كَذِبُهُ ذَهَبَ بَهَاؤُهُ .

text: From him, from Amro Bin Usman, from Muhammad Bin Salim, raising it, said, ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘It is befitting for the Muslim man that he keeps aside from the brotherhood of the lair, for he would lie to the extent that he would come with the truth but he would not be ratified’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:139
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) يَنْبَغِي لِلرَّجُلِ الْمُسْلِمِ أَنْ يَجْتَنِبَ مُوَاخَاةَ الْكَذَّابِ فَإِنَّهُ يَكْذِبُ حَتَّى يَجِي‏ءَ بِالصِّدْقِ فَلَا يُصَدَّقُ .

citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/334)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Yahya Al Wasity, from one of our companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The speech are three (types) – a truth, and a lie, and a reconciliation between the people’. He (the narrator) said, ‘It was said to him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>! What is the reconciliation between the people?’ He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘You hear speech from the man, had it reached him (the other one), it would have made him feel bad. Then you meet him, so you are saying, ‘I heard from so and so saying regarding you, such and such from the goodness’, opposite to what you had actually heard from him’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:139

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Al Hassan Al Sayqal who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘We have been reporting from Abu Ja’farasws regarding the words of Yusufas [12:70] O caravan! You are stealing’, and heasws said: ‘By Allahazwj! They were not stealing and heas did not lie (either). And Ibrahimas said: ‘[21:63] But (has) the chief of them has done this, therefore ask them, if they can speak. By Allahazwj! They (idols) had not done it, and heas did not lie’. He (the narrator) said, ‘So Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘What is with you all regarding it, O Sayqal?’ So I said, ‘There is nothing with us except for the submission’. So heasws said: ‘Allahazwj Loves two (things) and hates two. Heazwj Loves the danger in what is between the two swords and Loves the lie regarding the reconciliation; and Hates the danger in the roads and Hates the lie regarding other than the reconciliation. Ibrahimas, rather, said: ‘[21:63] But (has) the chief of them has done this, intending the reconciliation, and evidenced upon that they had not done it; and Yusufas intended the reconciliation’.

text: From him, from his father, from Safwan, from Abu Makhlad, from Isa Bin Hassan who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Every lie, its owner would be Questioned about it one day except for the lie regarding three (matters) – A man plans regarding his battle (in times of war) so it would be dropped from him; or a man who reconciles between two, saying to this one with other than what this had one had been said with, intending the reconciliation with that what is between the two; or a man who promises his family something and he does not intend to complete for them’.

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al hakam, from Abdullah Bin Yahya Al Kahily, from Muhammad Bin Malik, from Abdul A’ala, a slave of the family of Saam who said, ‘Abu Abdullahasws narrated to me with a Hadeeth, so I said to himasws, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! Did youasws not have a (Z’am) to me at such and such a time?’ So heasws said: ‘No’. So that was grievous upon me, so I said, ‘Yes, by Allahazwj, youasws did had a (Z’am)’. So heasws said: ‘No, by Allahazwj Iasws did not had such a (Z’am) about you. So it was grievous upon me, so I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! Yes, youasws did say it’. Heasws said: ‘Yes, Iasws had said it. But, do you not know that all (Z’am) in the Quran signify lies?’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:139
citation.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) بِحَدِيثٍ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ أَ لَيْسَ زَعَمْتَ لِيَ السَّاعَةَ كَذَا وَ كَذَا فَقَالَ لَا فَعَظُمَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيَّ فَقُلْتُ بَلَى وَ اللَّهِ زَعَمْتَ فَقَالَ لَا وَ اللَّهِ مَا زَعَمْتُهُ قَالَ فَعَظُمَ عَلَيَّ فَقُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ بَلَى وَ اللَّهِ قَدْ قُلْتَهُ قَالَ نَعَمْ قَدْ قُلْتُهُ أَ مَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ كُلَّ زَعْمٍ فِي الْقُرْآنِ كَذِبٌ .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Abu Is’haq Al Khurasany who said, ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws was saying: ‘Beware of the lie, for every hopeful one seeks, and every fearful one flees’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:139
citation.arabic_text: كَانَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( صلوات الله عليه ) يَقُولُ إِيَّاكُمْ وَ الْكَذِبَ فَإِنَّ كُلَّ رَاجٍ طَالِبٌ وَ كُلَّ خَائِفٍ هَارِبٌ .

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Al Hajjal, from Sa’alba, from Ma’mar Bin Amro, from Ata’a, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘There is no lie upon the reconciler’. Then heasws recited [12:70] O caravan! You are stealing, then said: ‘By Allahazwj! They were not stealing, and heas did not lie’. Then heasws recited [21:63] But (has) the chief of them has done this, therefore ask them, if they can speak. Then said: ‘By Allahazwj! They had not done it and heas did not lie’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:139

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Awn Al Qalanasy, from Ibn Abu Yafour, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who meets the Muslims by two faces and two tongues would come on the Day of Judgment and for him would be two tongues of Fire’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:140
citation.arabic_text: مَنْ لَقِيَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ بِوَجْهَيْنِ وَ لِسَانَيْنِ جَاءَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَ لَهُ لِسَانَانِ مِنْ نَارٍ .

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Usman Bin Isa, from Abu Shayba, from Al Zuhry, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘The worst servant is a servant who happens to be with two faces and with two tongues, flattering his brother when present and devouring (backbiting) him when absent. If his brother (in Eman) is given (a Bounty) he envies him, and if his brother (in Eman) is afflicted, abandons him’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:140
citation.arabic_text: بِئْسَ الْعَبْدُ عَبْدٌ يَكُونُ ذَا وَجْهَيْنِ وَ ذَا لِسَانَيْنِ يُطْرِي أَخَاهُ شَاهِداً وَ يَأْكُلُهُ غَائِباً إِنْ أُعْطِيَ حَسَدَهُ وَ إِنِ ابْتُلِيَ خَذَلَهُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Usman Bin Isa, from Abu Shayba, from Al Zuhry, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘The worst servant is a servant who happens to be with two faces and with two tongues, flattering his brother when present and devouring (backbiting) him when absent. If his brother (in Eman) is given (a Bounty) he envies him, and if his brother (in Eman) is afflicted, abandons him’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Abdul Rashman Bin Hammad, raising it, said, ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> blessed and High Said to Isa<sup>as</sup> Ibn Maryam<sup>as</sup>: “O Isa<sup>as</sup>! Let your<sup>as</sup> tongue during the privacy and the public be one tongue, and similar to that, your heart. I<sup>azwj</sup> Caution you<sup>as</sup> of yourself<sup>as</sup> and suffice with Me<sup>azwj</sup> as an All-Knowing. It is not correct for there to be two tongues in one mouth, nor two swords in one sheath, nor two hearts in one chest, and similar to that are the minds’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:140
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى لِعِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ ( عليه السلام ) يَا عِيسَى لِيَكُنْ لِسَانُكَ فِي السِّرِّ وَ الْعَلَانِيَةِ لِسَاناً وَاحِداً وَ كَذَلِكَ قَلْبُكَ إِنِّي أُحَذِّرُكَ نَفْسَكَ وَ كَفَى بِي خَبِيراً لَا يَصْلُحُ لِسَانَانِ فِي فَمٍ وَاحِدٍ وَ لَا سَيْفَانِ فِي غِمْدٍ وَاحِدٍ وَ لَا قَلْبَانِ فِي صَدْرٍ وَاحِدٍ وَ كَذَلِكَ الْأَذْهَانُ .

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Al Rabie, and a number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, raising it, said, ‘In a bequest of Al-Mufazzal, I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘No two men would separate upon the desertion except upon one of the two would Obligate the disowning and the cursing, and sometimes both of them deserve that’. So Mo’tab said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! This is the unjust one, so what is the matter with the oppressed one?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Because he did not leave his brother to good relations nor did he overlook from his speech. I<sup>asws</sup> heard my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘When two (people) dispute, so one overpowers the other, so let the oppressed return to his companion until he is saying to his companion, ‘Yes, my brother, I am the unjust’, until he cuts-off the fleeing between him and his companion, for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Judges justly. He<sup>azwj</sup> Seizes for the oppressed, from the oppressor’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:141
citation.arabic_text: فِي وَصِيَّةِ الْمُفَضَّلِ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ لَا يَفْتَرِقُ رَجُلَانِ عَلَى الْهِجْرَانِ إِلَّا اسْتَوْجَبَ أَحَدُهُمَا الْبَرَاءَةَ وَ اللَّعْنَةَ وَ رُبَّمَا اسْتَحَقَّ ذَلِكَ كِلَاهُمَا فَقَالَ لَهُ مُعَتِّبٌ جَعَلَنِيَ اللَّهُ فِدَاكَ هَذَا الظَّالِمُ فَمَا بَالُ الْمَظْلُومِ قَالَ لِأَنَّهُ لَا يَدْعُو أَخَاهُ إِلَى صِلَتِهِ وَ لَا يَتَغَامَسُ لَهُ عَنْ كَلَامِهِ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَقُولُ إِذَا تَنَازَعَ اثْنَانِ فَعَازَّ أَحَدُهُمَا الْآخَرَ فَلْيَرْجِعِ الْمَظْلُومُ إِلَى صَاحِبِهِ حَتَّى يَقُولَ لِصَاحِبِهِ أَيْ أَخِي أَنَا الظَّالِمُ حَتَّى يَقْطَعَ الْهِجْرَانَ بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ صَاحِبِهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى حَكَمٌ عَدْلٌ يَأْخُذُ لِلْمَظْلُومِ مِنَ الظَّالِمِ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘There should be no desertion (ceasing of relationship) for more than three (days)’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:141

text: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from Wuheyb Bin Hafs, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the man forsakes his relatives, from the ones who do not recognise the Truth. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is not befitting for him that he abandon them’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:141
citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَصْرِمُ ذَوِي قَرَابَتِهِ مِمَّنْ لَا يَعْرِفُ الْحَقَّ قَالَ لَا يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يَصْرِمَهُ .

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Hadeed, from his uncle Murazim Bin Hakeem who said, ‘It was so that in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> was a man from our companions titled as Shalqaan, and he<sup>asws</sup> had made him to be in charge regarding his<sup>asws</sup> finances, and he was of the evil manners, but he had deserted him<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me one day: ‘O murazim, and do you speak to Isa (Shalqaan)?’ So I said, ‘Yes’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You are correct. There is no goodness in the desertion’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:141

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Abu Saeed Al Qammat, from Dawood Bin Kaseer who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Whichever two Muslims desert each other, and they remain so for three (days) not reconciling, except that they both would have exited from Al-Islam, there would be no Wilayah between the two. citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:141

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibn Azina, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘The Satanla tempts the Momineen for as long as one of them does not return from his Religion. So when he does that, hela lies down upon hisla back and stretches, then says, ‘Ila have succeeded’. So May Allahazwj have Mercy on the person who unites between two friends of ourasws. O group of Momineen! Be united and sympathetic (to each other)!’

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:141
citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يُغْرِي بَيْنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَا لَمْ يَرْجِعْ أَحَدُهُمْ عَنْ دِينِهِ فَإِذَا فَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ اسْتَلْقَى عَلَى قَفَاهُ وَ تَمَدَّدَ ثُمَّ قَالَ فُزْتُ فَرَحِمَ اللَّهُ امْرَأً أَلَّفَ بَيْنَ وَلِيَّيْنِ لَنَا يَا مَعْشَرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ تَأَلَّفُوا وَ تَعَاطَفُوا .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibn Azina, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘The Satanla tempts the Momineen for as long as one of them does not return from his Religion. So when he does that, hela lies down upon hisla back and stretches, then says, ‘Ila have succeeded’. So May Allahazwj have Mercy on the person who unites between two friends of ourasws. O group of Momineen! Be united and sympathetic (to each other)!’
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/362)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Saeed, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, from Muhammad Bin Mahfouz, from Ali Bin Al Nu’man, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Iblees<sup>la</sup> does not cease to be joyful for as long as the two Muslims desert each other. So when they meet (reconcile), his<sup>la</sup> knees tremble and his<sup>la</sup> joints creak, and he<sup>la</sup> calls out, ‘O Woe, what I<sup>la</sup> face from the doom!’.

citation.arabic_text: لَا يَزَالُ إِبْلِيسُ فَرِحاً مَا اهْتَجَرَ الْمُسْلِمَانِ فَإِذَا الْتَقَيَا اصْطَكَّتْ رُكْبَتَاهُ وَ تَخَلَّعَتْ أَوْصَالُهُ وَ نَادَى يَا وَيْلَهُ مَا لَقِيَ مِنَ الثُّبُور .ُ

I said, ‘And what is the bareness?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Severing the relationships’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:142
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) اتَّقُوا الْحَالِقَةَ فَإِنَّهَا تُمِيتُ الرِّجَالَ قُلْتُ وَ مَا الْحَالِقَةُ قَالَ قَطِيعَةُ الرَّحِمِ .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, Usman Bin Isa, from one of our companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘My brothers and the sons of my uncle have constricted the house upon me and thrown me out from it to (another) house, and were I to speak to them, I could take what is in their hands’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Be patient, for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would be Making a relief to be for you’. He (the narrator) said, ‘So I left, and a plague occurred in the year one hundred and thirty one, so they (all died), by Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, all of them, and there did not remain (even) one from them. So I went out, and when I came over to him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘What is the state of your family?’ I said to him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, ‘They have died, by Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, all of them. So there does not remain (even) one’. So he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘It is due to what they did with you and their disloyalty to you, and severing your relationship with a cutting off. Would you love it if they were to remain (alive) and they had constricted (life) upon you?’ I said, ‘Yes, by Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:142
citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ إِخْوَتِي وَ بَنِي عَمِّي قَدْ ضَيَّقُوا عَلَيَّ الدَّارَ وَ أَلْجَئُونِي مِنْهَا إِلَى بَيْتٍ وَ لَوْ تَكَلَّمْتُ أَخَذْتُ مَا فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ قَالَ فَقَالَ لِيَ اصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ سَيَجْعَلُ لَكَ فَرَجاً قَالَ فَانْصَرَفْتُ وَ وَقَعَ الْوَبَاءُ فِي سَنَةِ إِحْدَى وَ ثَلَاثِينَ وَ مِائَةٍ فَمَاتُوا وَ اللَّهِ كُلُّهُمْ فَمَا بَقِيَ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدٌ قَالَ فَخَرَجْتُ فَلَمَّا دَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ مَا حَالُ أَهْلِ بَيْتِكَ قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ قَدْ مَاتُوا وَ اللَّهِ كُلُّهُمْ فَمَا بَقِيَ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدٌ فَقَالَ هُوَ بِمَا صَنَعُوا بِكَ وَ بِعُقُوقِهِمْ إِيَّاكَ وَ قَطْعِ رَحِمِهِمْ بُتِرُوا أَ تُحِبُّ أَنَّهُمْ بَقُوا وَ أَنَّهُمْ ضَيَّقُوا عَلَيْكَ قَالَ قُلْتُ إِي وَ اللَّهِ .

text: From him, from Ahmad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Malik Bin Atiyya, from Abu Ubeyda, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘In the Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup> (it is written): ‘There are three characteristics, its owner would not be dying ever until he sees its evil results – the tyranny, and the severing of the relationship, and the false oath to oppose Allah<sup>azwj</sup> with it; and that the quickest Rewards for the obedience is for the maintaining of the relationship. And that the people could be happening to be immoral, but they are maintaining relationships, so their wealth increases and they become rich. And the false oath and the severing of the relationships devastate the households by ruination from its inhabitants and transformation the relatives, and that the transformation of the relatives is cutting off of the lineages’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:142
citation.arabic_text: فِي كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ ( عليه السلام ) ثَلَاثُ خِصَالٍ لَا يَمُوتُ صَاحِبُهُنَّ أَبَداً حَتَّى يَرَى وَبَالَهُنَّ الْبَغْيُ وَ قَطِيعَةُ الرَّحِمِ وَ الْيَمِينُ الْكَاذِبَةُ يُبَارِزُ اللَّهَ بِهَا وَ إِنَّ أَعْجَلَ الطَّاعَةِ ثَوَاباً لَصِلَةُ الرَّحِمِ وَ إِنَّ الْقَوْمَ لَيَكُونُونَ فُجَّاراً فَيَتَوَاصَلُونَ فَتَنْمِي أَمْوَالُهُمْ وَ يُثْرُونَ وَ إِنَّ الْيَمِينَ الْكَاذِبَةَ وَ قَطِيعَةَ الرَّحِمِ لَتَذَرَانِ الدِّيَارَ بَلَاقِعَ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا وَ تَنْقُلُ الرَّحِمَ وَ إِنَّ نَقْلَ الرَّحِمِ انْقِطَاعُ النَّسْلِ .
citation.translation: From him, from Ahmad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Malik Bin Atiyya, from Abu Ubeyda, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘In the Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup> (it is written): ‘There are three characteristics, its owner would not be dying ever until he sees its evil results – the tyranny, and the severing of the relationship, and the false oath to oppose Allah<sup>azwj</sup> with it; and that the quickest Rewards for the obedience is for the maintaining of the relationship. And that the people could be happening to be immoral, but they are maintaining relationships, so their wealth increases and they become rich. And the false oath and the severing of the relationships devastate the households by ruination from its inhabitants and transformation the relatives, and that the transformation of the relatives is cutting off of the lineages’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Salih Bin Al Sindy, from Ja’far Bin Bashir, from Anbasa Al Aabid who said, ‘A man came over and he complained to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about his relatives. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘Suppress your anger and do (maintain relationships)’. So he said, ‘They are doing and doing (bad things)’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do you want to become similar to them, so that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would not Look at you?’

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:142
citation.arabic_text: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَشَكَا إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) أَقَارِبَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ اكْظِمْ غَيْظَكَ وَ افْعَلْ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُمْ يَفْعَلُونَ وَ يَفْعَلُونَ فَقَالَ أَ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِثْلَهُمْ فَلَا يَنْظُرَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ .

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:142
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) لَا تَقْطَعْ رَحِمَكَ وَ إِنْ قَطَعَتْكَ .

citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/369)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, raising it from Abu Hamza Al Sumaly who said, ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said in a sermon of hisasws: ‘I seek Refuge with Allahazwj from the sins which hasten the destruction’. So Abdullah Bin Al-Kawwa Al-Yashkuriy stood up to himasws, ‘O Amir Al-Momineenasws! And can the sins happen to hasten the destruction?’ So heasws said: ‘Yes, woe be unto you, (it is the) severing of the relationships. If the people of the household are gathering and co-operating with each other, while they are immoral, Allahazwj would Grace them, and if the people of the household are separating and cutting off from each other, Allahazwj would Deprive them while they are pious’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:142
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) فِي خُطْبَتِهِ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ الَّتِي تُعَجِّلُ الْفَنَاءَ فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْكَوَّاءِ الْيَشْكُرِيُّ فَقَالَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَ وَ تَكُونُ ذُنُوبٌ تُعَجِّلُ الْفَنَاءَ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ وَيْلَكَ قَطِيعَةُ الرَّحِمِ إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ لَيَجْتَمِعُونَ وَ يَتَوَاسَوْنَ وَ هُمْ فَجَرَةٌ فَيَرْزُقُهُمُ اللَّهُ وَ إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ لَيَتَفَرَّقُونَ وَ يَقْطَعُ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضاً فَيَحْرِمُهُمُ اللَّهُ وَ هُمْ أَتْقِيَاءُ .

text: From him, from Ibn Mahboub, from Malik Bin Atiyya, from Abu Hamza, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘When they (people) cut off the relationships, the wealth is Made to be in the hands of the evils ones’.

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Hadeed Bin Hakeym, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The least of the ingratitude is (the saying of) ‘Ugh’, and had Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Known of anything lesser than it, He<sup>azwj</sup> would have Forbidden from it’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) كُنْ بَارّاً وَ اقْتَصِرْ عَلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ عَاقّاً فَظّاً فَاقْتَصِرْ عَلَى النَّارِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Become righteous and shorten (your way) to the Paradise, and if you were ungrateful, hard-headed, so you would shorten (your way) to the Fire’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/371)

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Al Hassn Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Ubeys Bin Hisham, from Salih Al Haza’a, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When it will be the Day of Judgment, a cover from the covers of the Paradise would be uncovered, so its aroma would be smelt by the one who has a soul for him, from a travel distance of five hundred years, except for one type (of person)’. I said, ‘Who are they?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one ungrateful to his parents’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:143
citation.arabic_text: إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ كُشِفَ غِطَاءٌ مِنْ أَغْطِيَةِ الْجَنَّةِ فَوَجَدَ رِيحَهَا مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ رُوحٌ مِنْ مَسِيرَةِ خَمْسِمِائَةِ عَامٍ إِلَّا صِنْفٌ وَاحِدٌ قُلْتُ مَنْ هُمْ قَالَ الْعَاقُّ لِوَالِدَيْهِ .
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Al Hassn Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Ubeys Bin Hisham, from Salih Al Haza’a, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When it will be the Day of Judgment, a cover from the covers of the Paradise would be uncovered, so its aroma would be smelt by the one who has a soul for him, from a travel distance of five hundred years, except for one type (of person)’. I said, ‘Who are they?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one ungrateful to his parents’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/371)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Above every one with righteousness is a righteousness until the man being killed in the Way of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. So when he is killed in the Way of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, so there would be no righteousness above it; and above every disloyalty is a disloyalty until the man killing one of his parents. So when he does that, so there is no disloyalty above it’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:143
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) فَوْقَ كُلِّ ذِي بِرٍّ بِرٌّ حَتَّى يُقْتَلَ الرَّجُلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَإِذَا قُتِلَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَهُ بِرٌّ وَ إِنَّ فَوْقَ كُلِّ عُقُوقٍ عُقُوقاً حَتَّى يَقْتُلَ الرَّجُلُ أَحَدَ وَالِدَيْهِ فَإِذَا فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَهُ عُقُوقٌ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Above every one with righteousness is a righteousness until the man being killed in the Way of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. So when he is killed in the Way of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, so there would be no righteousness above it; and above every disloyalty is a disloyalty until the man killing one of his parents. So when he does that, so there is no disloyalty above it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/371)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one who looks at his parents abhorrently while they are being unjust to him, Allahazwj will not Accept (even a single) Salāt from him’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:143
citation.arabic_text: مَنْ نَظَرَ إِلَى أَبَوَيْهِ نَظَرَ مَاقِتٍ وَ هُمَا ظَالِمَانِ لَهُ لَمْ يَقْبَلِ اللَّهُ لَهُ صَلَاةً .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one who looks at his parents abhorrently while they are being unjust to him, Allahazwj will not Accept (even a single) Salāt from him’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح على الظاهر - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/372)

text: From him, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Muhammad Bin Furat, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said in a speech of his<sup>saww</sup>: ‘Beware of ingratitude to the parents, for the aroma of the Paradise would be found from a travel distance of a thousand years, and it will not be found by the ungrateful one, nor by a severer of the relationships, nor a elderly adulterer, nor by a dragger of his trousers (pompous one). But rather, the Greatness is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Lord<sup>azwj</sup> of the worlds’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:143
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) فِي كَلَامٍ لَهُ إِيَّاكُمْ وَ عُقُوقَ الْوَالِدَيْنِ فَإِنَّ رِيحَ الْجَنَّةِ تُوجَدُ مِنْ مَسِيرَةِ أَلْفِ عَامٍ وَ لَا يَجِدُهَا عَاقٌّ وَ لَا قَاطِعُ رَحِمٍ وَ لَا شَيْخٌ زَانٍ وَ لَا جَارُّ إِزَارِهِ خُيَلَاءَ إِنَّمَا الْكِبْرِيَاءُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ .
citation.translation: From him, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Muhammad Bin Furat, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said in a speech of his<sup>saww</sup>: ‘Beware of ingratitude to the parents, for the aroma of the Paradise would be found from a travel distance of a thousand years, and it will not be found by the ungrateful one, nor by a severer of the relationships, nor a elderly adulterer, nor by a dragger of his trousers (pompous one). But rather, the Greatness is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Lord<sup>azwj</sup> of the worlds’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/373)

text: From him, from Yahya Bin Ibrahim Bin Abu Ballad Al Sulmy, from his father, from his grandfather, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Had Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Known of anything lesser than (the saying of) ‘Ugh’, He<sup>azwj</sup> would have Forbidden from it, and it is the lowest of the ungratefulness; and from the ingratitude is that the man looks at his parents, so he looks angrily at them’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:143
citation.arabic_text: لَوْ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ شَيْئاً أَدْنَى مِنْ أُفٍّ لَنَهَى عَنْهُ وَ هُوَ مِنْ أَدْنَى الْعُقُوقِ وَ مِنَ الْعُقُوقِ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى وَالِدَيْهِ فَيُحِدَّ النَّظَرَ إِلَيْهِمَا .
citation.translation: From him, from Yahya Bin Ibrahim Bin Abu Ballad Al Sulmy, from his father, from his grandfather, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Had Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Known of anything lesser than (the saying of) ‘Ugh’, He<sup>azwj</sup> would have Forbidden from it, and it is the lowest of the ungratefulness; and from the ingratitude is that the man looks at his parents, so he looks angrily at them’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/374)

text: Ali, from his father, from Haroun Bin Al Jahm, from Abdullah Bin Suleyman, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> looked at a man and with him was his son, walking, and the son was leaning upon the arm of the father. So my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> did not speak to him in aversion (so not to distract him) to him until he<sup>asws</sup> separated from the world’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:143
citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ أَبِي نَظَرَ إِلَى رَجُلٍ وَ مَعَهُ ابْنُهُ يَمْشِي وَ الِابْنُ مُتَّكِئٌ عَلَى ذِرَاعِ الْأَبِ قَالَ فَمَا كَلَّمَهُ أَبِي ( عليه السلام ) مَقْتاً لَهُ حَتَّى فَارَقَ الدُّنْيَا .
citation.translation: Ali, from his father, from Haroun Bin Al Jahm, from Abdullah Bin Suleyman, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> looked at a man and with him was his son, walking, and the son was leaning upon the arm of the father. So my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> did not speak to him in aversion (so not to distract him) to him until he<sup>asws</sup> separated from the world’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/375)

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhassin Bin Ahmad, from Aban Bin usman, from Hadeed Bin Hakeym, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdulllah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The lowest of the disloyalty is (the saying of) ‘Ugh’, and had Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Known of anything less than it, He<sup>azwj</sup> would have Forbidden from it’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:143
citation.arabic_text: أَدْنَى الْعُقُوقِ أُفٍّ وَ لَوْ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ أَيْسَرَ مِنْهُ لَنَهَى عَنْهُ .
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhassin Bin Ahmad, from Aban Bin usman, from Hadeed Bin Hakeym, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdulllah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The lowest of the disloyalty is (the saying of) ‘Ugh’, and had Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Known of anything less than it, He<sup>azwj</sup> would have Forbidden from it’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘He has disbelieved in Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, the one who disavows from a lineage, and even if it was lowly’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:144
citation.arabic_text: كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ مَنْ تَبَرَّأَ مِنْ نَسَبٍ وَ إِنْ دَقَّ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘He has disbelieved in Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, the one who disavows from a lineage, and even if it was lowly’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/376)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Al Magra, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘He has disbelieved in Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, the one who disavows from a lineage, and even if it was lowly’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:144
citation.arabic_text: كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ مَنْ تَبَرَّأَ مِنْ نَسَبٍ وَ إِنْ دَقَّ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Al Magra, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘He has disbelieved in Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, the one who disavows from a lineage, and even if it was lowly’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/376)

text: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Salih Bin Abu Hammad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, and Ibn Fazzal, from various men, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that they<sup>asws</sup> both said: ‘It is disbelief in Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Magnificent, the disowning of a lineage, and even if it was lowly’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:144
citation.arabic_text: ا كُفْرٌ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ الِانْتِفَاءُ مِنْ حَسَبٍ وَ إِنْ دَقَّ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Salih Bin Abu Hammad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, and Ibn Fazzal, from various men, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that they<sup>asws</sup> both said: ‘It is disbelief in Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Magnificent, the disowning of a lineage, and even if it was lowly’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/376)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham Bin Salim who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Says: “Let there be a Proclamation of a war from Meazwj (upon the) one who hurts Myazwj Momin servant, and let him be safe from Myazwj Anger, the one who honours Myazwj Momin servant. And had there not happened to be from Myazwj creatures in the earth, in what is between the east and the west except for one Momin along with a just Imamasws, Iazwj would have Sufficed by their worship from the entirety of what Iazwj Created in Myazwj earth, and Iazwj would have Established the seven skies and the earths due to them both, and would have Made for them both a comfort for them from their Emān, so they would not be needy to a comfort for anyone besides themselves’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:145
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لِيَأْذَنْ بِحَرْبٍ مِنِّي مَنْ آذَى عَبْدِيَ الْمُؤْمِنَ وَ لْيَأْمَنْ غَضَبِي مَنْ أَكْرَمَ عَبْدِيَ الْمُؤْمِنَ وَ لَوْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مِنْ خَلْقِي فِي الْأَرْضِ فِيمَا بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَ الْمَغْرِبِ إِلَّا مُؤْمِنٌ وَاحِدٌ مَعَ إِمَامٍ عَادِلٍ لَاسْتَغْنَيْتُ بِعِبَادَتِهِمَا عَنْ جَمِيعِ مَا خَلَقْتُ فِي أَرْضِي وَ لَقَامَتْ سَبْعُ سَمَاوَاتٍ وَ أَرَضِينَ بِهِمَا وَ لَجَعَلْتُ لَهُمَا مِنْ إِيمَانِهِمَا أُنْساً لَا يَحْتَاجَانِ إِلَى أُنْسِ سِوَاهُمَا .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham Bin Salim who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Says: “Let there be a Proclamation of a war from Meazwj (upon the) one who hurts Myazwj Momin servant, and let him be safe from Myazwj Anger, the one who honours Myazwj Momin servant. And had there not happened to be from Myazwj creatures in the earth, in what is between the east and the west except for one Momin along with a just Imamasws, Iazwj would have Sufficed by their worship from the entirety of what Iazwj Created in Myazwj earth, and Iazwj would have Established the seven skies and the earths due to them both, and would have Made for them both a comfort for them from their Emān, so they would not be needy to a comfort for anyone besides themselves’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (10/377)

text: From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Sinan, from Munzir Bin Yazeed, from Al Mufazzal Bin Umar who said, ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘When it will be the Day of Judgment, a Caller would Call out: “Where are those hinderers who troubled Myazwj friends?” So a group would stand, there not being any flesh upon their faces, and it would be said: ‘These are the ones who hurt the Momineen and established (hostility) to them (Nasibis), and were stubborn on them and were violent to them regarding their Religion!’ Then Heazwj would Command with them to Hell’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:145
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ نَادَى مُنَادٍ أَيْنَ الصُّدُودُ لِأَوْلِيَائِي فَيَقُومُ قَوْمٌ لَيْسَ عَلَى وُجُوهِهِمْ لَحْمٌ فَيُقَالُ هَؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ آذَوُا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ نَصَبُوا لَهُمْ وَ عَانَدُوهُمْ وَ عَنَّفُوهُمْ فِي دِينِهِمْ ثُمَّ يُؤْمَرُ بِهِمْ إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ .
citation.translation: From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Sinan, from Munzir Bin Yazeed, from Al Mufazzal Bin Umar who said, ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘When it will be the Day of Judgment, a Caller would Call out: “Where are those hinderers who troubled Myazwj friends?” So a group would stand, there not being any flesh upon their faces, and it would be said: ‘These are the ones who hurt the Momineen and established (hostility) to them (Nasibis), and were stubborn on them and were violent to them regarding their Religion!’ Then Heazwj would Command with them to Hell’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/378)

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Ibn Fazzal, from Sa’alba Bin Maymoun, from Hammad Bin Bashir, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Says: “The one who despises (hates) a friend of Mine<sup>azwj</sup>, so he has declared a war against Me<sup>azwj</sup>”’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:145
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) قَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى مَنْ أَهَانَ لِي وَلِيّاً فَقَدْ أَرْصَدَ لِمُحَارَبَتِي .
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Ibn Fazzal, from Sa’alba Bin Maymoun, from Hammad Bin Bashir, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Says: “The one who despises (hates) a friend of Mine<sup>azwj</sup>, so he has declared a war against Me<sup>azwj</sup>”’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (0/379)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Husayn Bin Usman, from Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one who considers a Momin as insignificant, be he a poor or without poverty, Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic will not Cease to Look down at him Angrily until he retracts from his belittling him’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:145

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, and Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, altogether from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali Bin Uqba, from Hammad Bin Bashir who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Said: “The one who despises a friend of Mineazwj to Meazwj, so he has declared a war against Meazwj; and a servant will not (be able to) come near to Meazwj with anything more Beloved to Meazwj than what Iazwj have Obligated upon him, and let him come closer to Meazwj with the Optional (Salāt) until Iazwj Love him. So when Iazwj do Love him, Iazwj would be the hearing which he listens with, and his vision which he sees with, and his tongue which he speaks with, and his hand which he strikes with. If he were to supplicate to Meazwj, Iazwj would Answer him, and if he were to ask Meazwj, Iazwj would Give it to him; and Iazwj do not Hesitate from anything which Iazwj Do like Iazwj Hesitate from the death of the Momin. He dislikes the death and Iazwj Dislike Disappointing him”’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:145

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of his companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one who disgraces a Momin and belittles him due to the little of what is in his hands and for his poverty, Allahazwj would Publicise him (his evil deeds) on the Day of Judgment upon the heads of the creatures’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Muawiya, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘My<sup>azwj</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> Ascended me<sup>saww</sup> (Mi’raj) and He<sup>azwj</sup> Revealed unto me<sup>saww</sup> from behind the Veil what He<sup>azwj</sup> Revealed and Spoke to Me<sup>azwj</sup> Verbally until He<sup>azwj</sup> Said to me<sup>saww</sup>: ‘O Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>! “O Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>! And who is this friend of Yours<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, for I<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> have known that the one who battles You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> would battle him?’ He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Said to me: “That is the one from whom I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> have Taken the Covenant for you<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup>, and for your<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> successor<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, and for both your<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> children with the Wilayah”’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, from Moalla Bin Khunays, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said:’ Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Says: “The one who disgraces a Momin so he has initiated a war against Meazwj, and Iazwj do not Hesitate with anything that Iazwj Do like Iazwj Hesitate regarding Myazwj Momin servant.
