text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad Al Nahdy, raising it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Nine characteristics have been Dropped from my<sup>saww</sup> community – the mistake, and the forgetfulness, and what they are not knowing, and what they are not enduring, and what they are desperate to, and what they are compelled upon, and the evil omen, and the uncertainty in the pondering in the creation, and the envy what is not made apparent either by the tongue or the hand’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:208
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) وُضِعَ عَنْ أُمَّتِي تِسْعُ خِصَالٍ الْخَطَأُ وَ النِّسْيَانِ وَ مَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ وَ مَا لَا يُطِيقُونَ وَ مَا اضْطُرُّوا إِلَيْهِ وَ مَا اسْتُكْرِهُوا عَلَيْهِ وَ الطِّيَرَةُ وَ الْوَسْوَسَةُ فِي التَّفَكُّرِ فِي الْخَلْقِ وَ الْحَسَدُ مَا لَمْ يُظْهِرْ بِلِسَانٍ أَوْ يَدٍ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad Al Nahdy, raising it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Nine characteristics have been Dropped from my<sup>saww</sup> community – the mistake, and the forgetfulness, and what they are not knowing, and what they are not enduring, and what they are desperate to, and what they are compelled upon, and the evil omen, and the uncertainty in the pondering in the creation, and the envy what is not made apparent either by the tongue or the hand’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرفوع - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (11/391)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Is there for anyone an Obligated Reward for what he does except for the Momineen?’ Heasws said: ‘No’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:209
citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) هَلْ لِأَحَدٍ عَلَى مَا عَمِلَ ثَوَابٌ عَلَى اللَّهِ مُوجَبٌ إِلَّا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ قَالَ لَا .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Is there for anyone an Obligated Reward for what he does except for the Momineen?’ Heasws said: ‘No’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (1/395)

text: From him, from Yunus, from one of his companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Musaas said to Al-Khizras: ‘You have sanctified meas by youras company, therefore advise meas’. Heas said to himas: ‘Necessitate (Emān) what would not harm youas anything along with it, just as it would not benefit youas anything along with other than it’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:209
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ مُوسَى لِلْخَضِرِ ( عليه السلام ) قَدْ تَحَرَّمْتُ بِصُحْبَتِكَ فَأَوْصِنِي قَالَ لَهُ الْزَمْ مَا لَا يَضُرُّكَ مَعَهُ شَيْ‏ءٌ كَمَا لَا يَنْفَعُكَ مَعَ غَيْرِهِ شَيْ‏ءٌ .
citation.translation: From him, from Yunus, from one of his companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Musaas said to Al-Khizras: ‘You have sanctified meas by youras company, therefore advise meas’. Heas said to himas: ‘Necessitate (Emān) what would not harm youas anything along with it, just as it would not benefit youas anything along with other than it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (11/396)

text: From him, from Yunus, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Abu Ameyt Yusuf Bin Sabit who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Along with Emān, no deed would harm you, nor would a deed benefit you along with Kufr (disbelief). Do you not see that Heazwj Said [9:54] And nothing hinders their spending being Accepted from them, except that they disbelieve in Allah and in His Rasool, and they are dying while they are disbelievers (Kafiroun)’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:209
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ الْإِيمَانِ عَمَلٌ وَ لَا يَنْفَعُ مَعَ الْكُفْرِ عَمَلٌ أَ لَا تَرَى أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَ ما مَنَعَهُمْ أَنْ تُقْبَلَ مِنْهُمْ نَفَقاتُهُمْ إِلَّا أَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا بِاللَّهِ وَ بِرَسُولِهِ وَ مَاتُوا وَ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ .
citation.translation: From him, from Yunus, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Abu Ameyt Yusuf Bin Sabit who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Along with Emān, no deed would harm you, nor would a deed benefit you along with Kufr (disbelief). Do you not see that Heazwj Said [9:54] And nothing hinders their spending being Accepted from them, except that they disbelieve in Allah and in His Rasool, and they are dying while they are disbelievers (Kafiroun)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (1/396)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Sa’alba, from Abu Ameyt Yusuf Bin Sabi Bin Abu Sa’da, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The Emān is such that no deed would harm along with it, and similar to that is the Kufr (disbelief), no deed would benefit along with it’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:209
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ الْإِيمَانُ لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَهُ عَمَلٌ وَ كَذَلِكَ الْكُفْرُ لَا يَنْفَعُ مَعَهُ عَمَلٌ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Sa’alba, from Abu Ameyt Yusuf Bin Sabi Bin Abu Sa’da, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The Emān is such that no deed would harm along with it, and similar to that is the Kufr (disbelief), no deed would benefit along with it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (11/397)

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from the one who mentioned it, from Ubed Bin Zurara, from Muhammad Bin Marid who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A Hadeeth has been reported to us that you<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When you recognise (Al-Wilaya) so you can do whatever you so desire to’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> have said that’. I said, ‘And even if they commit adultery, or are stealing, or drinking the wine?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘We are from Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and to Him<sup>azwj</sup> we are returning. By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! They have not been fair to us<sup>asws</sup>, that we<sup>asws</sup> would be Seized with the deed and it has been Dropped from them? But rather, I<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘When you recognise (Al-Wilayah), so do whatever you so desire to, be it from the little goodness and more, for it would be Accepted from you’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:209
citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) حَدِيثٌ رُوِيَ لَنَا أَنَّكَ قُلْتَ إِذَا عَرَفْتَ فَاعْمَلْ مَا شِئْتَ فَقَالَ قَدْ قُلْتُ ذَلِكَ قَالَ قُلْتُ وَ إِنْ زَنَوْا أَوْ سَرَقُوا أَوْ شَرِبُوا الْخَمْرَ فَقَالَ لِي إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَ إِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ وَ اللَّهِ مَا أَنْصَفُونَا أَنْ نَكُونَ أُخِذْنَا بِالْعَمَلِ وَ وُضِعَ عَنْهُمْ إِنَّمَا قُلْتُ إِذَا عَرَفْتَ فَاعْمَلْ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ قَلِيلِ الْخَيْرِ وَ كَثِيرِهِ فَإِنَّهُ يُقْبَلُ مِنْكَ .

citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (11/397)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Al Rayyan Bin Al Salt, raising it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘It was so that Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> was frequently saying in his<sup>asws</sup> sermons: ‘O you people! Your Religion is your Religion, So the evil deed in it is better than the good deed in other (Religions), and the evil deed in it would be Forgiven, and the good deed in the other (Religions) would not be Accepted’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF BELIEF (Emān) AND DISBELIEF (KUFR) (al-Kafi, vol 2), 1:209
citation.arabic_text: كَانَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) كَثِيراً مَا يَقُولُ فِي خُطْبَتِهِ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ دِينَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ فَإِنَّ السَّيِّئَةَ فِيهِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْحَسَنَةِ فِي غَيْرِهِ وَ السَّيِّئَةُ فِيهِ تُغْفَرُ وَ الْحَسَنَةُ فِي غَيْرِهِ لَا تُقْبَلُ .

citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرفوع - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (11/398)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [40:60] surely those who are too proud to worship Me shall soon enter Hell abased. It (worship) is the supplication, and the most superior of the (acts of) worship, is the supplication’. I said, ‘[9:114] most surely Ibrahim was very tender-hearted, forbearing’. Heasws said: ‘His tender-heartedness, it is (a reference to) the supplication’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:1
citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَقُولُ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبادَتِي سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ داخِرِينَ قَالَ هُوَ الدُّعَاءُ وَ أَفْضَلُ الْعِبَادَةِ الدُّعَاءُ قُلْتُ إِنَّ إِبْراهِيمَ لَأَوَّاهٌ حَلِيمٌ قَالَ الْأَوَّاهُ هُوَ الدَّعَّاءُ .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail and Ibn Mahboub, altogether from Hanan Bin Sadeyr, from his father who said, ‘I said to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Which of the (acts of) worship is most superior?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is none from the things more superior in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic that He<sup>azwj</sup> should be asked and sought from for what is with Him<sup>azwj</sup>. There is no one more Hateful to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic than the one who is too arrogant from worshipping Him<sup>azwj</sup> and he does not ask for what is with Him<sup>azwj</sup>’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:1
citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) أَيُّ الْعِبَادَةِ أَفْضَلُ فَقَالَ مَا مِنْ شَيْ‏ءٍ أَفْضَلَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مِنْ أَنْ يُسْئَلَ وَ يُطْلَبَ مِمَّا عِنْدَهُ وَ مَا أَحَدٌ أَبْغَضَ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مِمَّنْ يَسْتَكْبِرُ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِ وَ لَا يَسْأَلُ مَا عِنْدَهُ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail and Ibn Mahboub, altogether from Hanan Bin Sadeyr, from his father who said, ‘I said to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Which of the (acts of) worship is most superior?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is none from the things more superior in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic that He<sup>azwj</sup> should be asked and sought from for what is with Him<sup>azwj</sup>. There is no one more Hateful to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic than the one who is too arrogant from worshipping Him<sup>azwj</sup> and he does not ask for what is with Him<sup>azwj</sup>’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/3)

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Muyassir Bin Abdul Aziz, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘O Muyassir! Supplicate and do not say that the matter has already been decided. In the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Might and Majestic there is a status which cannot be achieved except by asking (for it), and if a servant was to close his mouth and not ask, he would not be Given a thing. Therefore ask, you will be Given. O Muyassir! There is no door which is knocked upon except it is imminent that it would be opened for its comer’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:1
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لِي يَا مُيَسِّرُ ادْعُ وَ لَا تَقُلْ إِنَّ الْأَمْرَ قَدْ فُرِغَ مِنْهُ إِنَّ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مَنْزِلَةً لَا تُنَالُ إِلَّا بِمَسْأَلَةٍ وَ لَوْ أَنَّ عَبْداً سَدَّ فَاهُ وَ لَمْ يَسْأَلْ لَمْ يُعْطَ شَيْئاً فَسَلْ تُعْطَ يَا مُيَسِّرُ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ بَابٍ يُقْرَعُ إِلَّا يُوشِكُ أَنْ يُفْتَحَ لِصَاحِبِهِ .
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Muyassir Bin Abdul Aziz, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘O Muyassir! Supplicate and do not say that the matter has already been decided. In the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Might and Majestic there is a status which cannot be achieved except by asking (for it), and if a servant was to close his mouth and not ask, he would not be Given a thing. Therefore ask, you will be Given. O Muyassir! There is no door which is knocked upon except it is imminent that it would be opened for its comer’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/4)

text: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Khashhab, from Ibn Baqah, from Muaz, from Amro Bin Jumie, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who does not ask Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic of His<sup>azwj</sup> Grace, so he would become poor’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:1
citation.arabic_text: مَنْ لَمْ يَسْأَلِ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ فَقَدِ افْتَقَرَ .
citation.translation: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Khashhab, from Ibn Baqah, from Muaz, from Amro Bin Jumie, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who does not ask Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic of His<sup>azwj</sup> Grace, so he would become poor’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/6)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I heard himasws saying: ‘Supplicate and do not say that the matter has already been decided, for the supplication, it is the worship. Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [40:60] surely those who are too proud to worship Me shall soon enter Hell abased. And Said [40:60] Call upon Me, I will Answer you’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:1
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ادْعُ وَ لَا تَقُلْ قَدْ فُرِغَ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ فَإِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ هُوَ الْعِبَادَةُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَقُولُ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبادَتِي سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ داخِرِينَ وَ قَالَ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I heard himasws saying: ‘Supplicate and do not say that the matter has already been decided, for the supplication, it is the worship. Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [40:60] surely those who are too proud to worship Me shall soon enter Hell abased. And Said [40:60] Call upon Me, I will Answer you’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/6)

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Sayf Al Tammar who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘It is upon you to supplicate as you will not get closer (to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>) with anything similar to it, nor should you neglect supplicating for a small (thing) due to its smallness. He<sup>azwj</sup> is the Owner of the small as well as the big (things)’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:1
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالدُّعَاءِ فَإِنَّكُمْ لَا تَقَرَّبُونَ بِمِثْلِهِ وَ لَا تَتْرُكُوا صَغِيرَةً لِصِغَرِهَا أَنْ تَدْعُوا بِهَا إِنَّ صَاحِبَ الصِّغَارِ هُوَ صَاحِبُ الْكِبَارِ .
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Sayf Al Tammar who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘It is upon you to supplicate as you will not get closer (to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>) with anything similar to it, nor should you neglect supplicating for a small (thing) due to its smallness. He<sup>azwj</sup> is the Owner of the small as well as the big (things)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/8)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Al Qasim Bin Suleyman, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara, from his father, from a man who said, ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘The supplication, it is the worship which Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Spoke of [40:60] surely those who are too proud to worship Me – the Verse. Supplicate to Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic and do not say that the matter has already been decided’. Zurara (the narrator) said, ‘But rather, it means that your belief in the Ordainment and the Pre-determination whould not prevent you that you should speak with the supplication and strive in his, or just as heasws said’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:1
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) الدُّعَاءُ هُوَ الْعِبَادَةُ الَّتِي قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبادَتِي الْآيَة ادْعُ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ لَا تَقُلْ إِنَّ الْأَمْرَ قَدْ فُرِغَ مِنْهُ قَالَ زُرَارَةُ إِنَّمَا يَعْنِي لَا يَمْنَعْكَ إِيمَانُكَ بِالْقَضَاءِ وَ الْقَدَرِ أَنْ تُبَالِغَ بِالدُّعَاءِ وَ تَجْتَهِدَ فِيهِ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Al Qasim Bin Suleyman, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara, from his father, from a man who said, ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘The supplication, it is the worship which Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Spoke of [40:60] surely those who are too proud to worship Me – the Verse. Supplicate to Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic and do not say that the matter has already been decided’. Zurara (the narrator) said, ‘But rather, it means that your belief in the Ordainment and the Pre-determination whould not prevent you that you should speak with the supplication and strive in his, or just as heasws said’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/8)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘The most Beloved of the deeds to Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic in the earth, is the supplication, and the most superior of the (acts of) worship is the chastity’. Heasws said: ‘And Amir Al-Momineenasws was a (frequently) supplicating person’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:1
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) أَحَبُّ الْأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِي الْأَرْضِ الدُّعَاءُ وَ أَفْضَلُ الْعِبَادَةِ الْعَفَافُ قَالَ وَ كَانَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) رَجُلًا دَعَّاءً .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘The most Beloved of the deeds to Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic in the earth, is the supplication, and the most superior of the (acts of) worship is the chastity’. Heasws said: ‘And Amir Al-Momineenasws was a (frequently) supplicating person’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/9)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The supplication is a weapon of the Momin and a pillar of the Religion, and a Light of the skies and the earth’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:2
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) الدُّعَاءُ سِلَاحُ الْمُؤْمِنِ وَ عَمُودُ الدِّينِ وَ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The supplication is a weapon of the Momin and a pillar of the Religion, and a Light of the skies and the earth’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/10)

text: And by this chain, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The supplications are the keys to achievement and collars of the success, and the best of the supplication is what is generated by a clean chest and a fearful heart’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:2
citation.arabic_text: وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ قَالَ قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) الدُّعَاءُ مَفَاتِيحُ النَّجَاحِ وَ مَقَالِيدُ الْفَلَاحِ وَ خَيْرُ الدُّعَاءِ مَا صَدَرَ عَنْ صَدْرٍ نَقِيٍّ وَ قَلْبٍ تَقِيٍّ وَ فِي الْمُنَاجَاةِ سَبَبُ النَّجَاةِ وَ بِالْإِخْلَاصِ يَكُونُ الْخَلَاصُ فَإِذَا اشْتَدَّ الْفَزَعُ فَإِلَى اللَّهِ الْمَفْزَعُ .
citation.translation: And by this chain, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The supplications are the keys to achievement and collars of the success, and the best of the supplication is what is generated by a clean chest and a fearful heart’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/10)

text: And by his chain, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Indeed! Shall I<sup>saww</sup> point you all to a weapon to save you from your enemies and generate your sustenance?’ So they said, ‘Yes’. He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘You should be supplicating to your Lord<sup>azwj</sup> by the night and the day, for a weapon of the Believers, it is the supplication’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:2
citation.arabic_text: وَ بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَ لَا أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى سِلَاحٍ يُنْجِيكُمْ مِنْ أَعْدَائِكُمْ وَ يُدِرُّ أَرْزَاقَكُمْ قَالُوا بَلَى قَالَ تَدْعُونَ رَبَّكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ فَإِنَّ سِلَاحَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الدُّعَاءُ .
citation.translation: And by his chain, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Indeed! Shall I<sup>saww</sup> point you all to a weapon to save you from your enemies and generate your sustenance?’ So they said, ‘Yes’. He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘You should be supplicating to your Lord<sup>azwj</sup> by the night and the day, for a weapon of the Believers, it is the supplication’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/11)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘The supplication is a shield of the Momin, and when the door is knocked upon frequently, it would be opened for you’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:2
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) الدُّعَاءُ تُرْسُ الْمُؤْمِنِ وَ مَتَى تُكْثِرْ قَرْعَ الْبَابِ يُفْتَحْ لَكَ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘The supplication is a shield of the Momin, and when the door is knocked upon frequently, it would be opened for you’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/12)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibm Fazzal, from one of our companions, (It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having frequently said to his<sup>asws</sup> companions: ‘It is upon you to be with a weapon of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>’. So it was said, ‘What is a weapon of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The supplication’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:2
citation.arabic_text: لِأَصْحَابِهِ عَلَيْكُمْ بِسِلَاحِ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ فَقِيلَ وَ مَا سِلَاحُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ قَالَ الدُّعَاءُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibm Fazzal, from one of our companions, (It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having frequently said to his<sup>asws</sup> companions: ‘It is upon you to be with a weapon of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>’. So it was said, ‘What is a weapon of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The supplication’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/12)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Abu Saeed Al Bajaly who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The supplication is more piercing than the spear-heads’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:2
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ أَنْفَذُ مِنَ السِّنَانِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Abu Saeed Al Bajaly who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The supplication is more piercing than the spear-heads’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/12)

text: From him, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The supplication is more piercing than the spear-heads of the iron’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:2
citation.arabic_text: الدُّعَاءُ أَنْفَذُ مِنَ السِّنَانِ الْحَدِيدِ .
citation.translation: From him, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The supplication is more piercing than the spear-heads of the iron’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/12)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman who said, ‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The supplication repels the Ordainment and breaks it just as the rope does, and although it has been twirled and twisted (strong)’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:3
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ إِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ يَرُدُّ الْقَضَاءَ يَنْقُضُهُ كَمَا يُنْقَضُ السِّلْكُ وَ قَدْ أُبْرِمَ إِبْرَاماً .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman who said, ‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The supplication repels the Ordainment and breaks it just as the rope does, and although it has been twirled and twisted (strong)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/12)

text: From him, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Umar Bin Yazeed who said, ‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The supplication repels what has been Pre-determined and what has not been Pre-determined’. I said, ‘And what has been Pre-determined, I recognise it, so what has not been Pre-determined?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Until it does not happen’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:3
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ إِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ يَرُدُّ مَا قَدْ قُدِّرَ وَ مَا لَمْ يُقَدَّرْ قُلْتُ وَ مَا قَدْ قُدِّرَ عَرَفْتُهُ فَمَا لَمْ يُقَدَّرْ قَالَ حَتَّى لَا يَكُونَ .
citation.translation: From him, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Umar Bin Yazeed who said, ‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The supplication repels what has been Pre-determined and what has not been Pre-determined’. I said, ‘And what has been Pre-determined, I recognise it, so what has not been Pre-determined?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Until it does not happen’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/13)

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Bistam Al Zayyat, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘A supplication repels the Pre-determined (matters) and although it has descended from the sky and has been strengthened with a strengthening’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:3
citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ يَرُدُّ الْقَضَاءَ وَ قَدْ نَزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَ قَدْ أُبْرِمَ إِبْرَاماً .
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Bistam Al Zayyat, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘A supplication repels the Pre-determined (matters) and although it has descended from the sky and has been strengthened with a strengthening’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/13)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Hammam Ismail Bin Hammad, (It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al Husayn<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The supplication and the affliction would both be together up to the Day of Judgment. The supplication repels the affliction and although it has been strengthened with a strengthening’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:3
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ ( عليه السلام ) إِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ وَ الْبَلَاءَ لَيَتَرَافَقَانِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ لَيَرُدُّ الْبَلَاءَ وَ قَدْ أُبْرِمَ إِبْرَاماً.
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Hammam Ismail Bin Hammad, (It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al Husayn<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The supplication and the affliction would both be together up to the Day of Judgment. The supplication repels the affliction and although it has been strengthened with a strengthening’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/14)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washa, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘The supplication repels the affliction, the descended one and what has not descended yet’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:3
citation.arabic_text: كَانَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ الدُّعَاءُ يَدْفَعُ الْبَلَاءَ النَّازِلَ وَ مَا لَمْ يَنْزِلْ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washa, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘The supplication repels the affliction, the descended one and what has not descended yet’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/14)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Shall I<sup>asws</sup> point you to something which Rasool-Allah<sup>azwj</sup> did not make an exclusion in it?’ I said, ‘Yes’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘A supplication repels the Ordainment and although it has been strengthened with a strengthening’, and he<sup>asws</sup> clasped his<sup>asws</sup> fingers’ (to demonstrate it).

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:3
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لِي أَ لَا أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى شَيْ‏ءٍ لَمْ يَسْتَثْنِ فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) قُلْتُ بَلَى قَالَ الدُّعَاءُ يَرُدُّ الْقَضَاءَ وَ قَدْ أُبْرِمَ إِبْرَاماً وَ ضَمَّ أَصَابِعَهُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Shall I<sup>asws</sup> point you to something which Rasool-Allah<sup>azwj</sup> did not make an exclusion in it?’ I said, ‘Yes’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘A supplication repels the Ordainment and although it has been strengthened with a strengthening’, and he<sup>asws</sup> clasped his<sup>asws</sup> fingers’ (to demonstrate it).
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/15)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘A supplication repels the Ordained matter what has been strengthened with a strengthening, therefore frequent from the supplications for these are the keys to every Mercy and an achievement for every need, and whatever is with Allah<sup>azwj</sup> cannot be attained except by the supplication; and there is no door which is frequently knocked upon except that it is imminent that it would be opened for its comer’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:3
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ الدُّعَاءُ يَرُدُّ الْقَضَاءَ بَعْدَ مَا أُبْرِمَ إِبْرَاماً فَأَكْثِرْ مِنَ الدُّعَاءِ فَإِنَّهُ مِفْتَاحُ كُلِّ رَحْمَةٍ وَ نَجَاحُ كُلِّ حَاجَةٍ وَ لَا يُنَالُ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَّا بِالدُّعَاءِ وَ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بَابٌ يُكْثَرُ قَرْعُهُ إِلَّا يُوشِكُ أَنْ يُفْتَحَ لِصَاحِبِهِ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘A supplication repels the Ordained matter what has been strengthened with a strengthening, therefore frequent from the supplications for these are the keys to every Mercy and an achievement for every need, and whatever is with Allah<sup>azwj</sup> cannot be attained except by the supplication; and there is no door which is frequently knocked upon except that it is imminent that it would be opened for its comer’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/15)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Wallad who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon you is with the supplication, for the supplicating to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and seeking to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> repels the affliction and although it has been Pre-determined and there does not remain except for its coming to pass. So when Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is supplicated (to) and asked (from), He<sup>azwj</sup> Dismisses the affliction with a Dismissal’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:3
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى ( عليه السلام ) عَلَيْكُمْ بِالدُّعَاءِ فَإِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ لِلَّهِ وَ الطَّلَبَ إِلَى اللَّهِ يَرُدُّ الْبَلَاءَ وَ قَدْ قُدِّرَ وَ قُضِيَ وَ لَمْ يَبْقَ إِلَّا إِمْضَاؤُهُ فَإِذَا دُعِيَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ سُئِلَ صُرِفَ الْبَلَاءُ صَرْفَةً .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Wallad who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon you is with the supplication, for the supplicating to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and seeking to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> repels the affliction and although it has been Pre-determined and there does not remain except for its coming to pass. So when Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is supplicated (to) and asked (from), He<sup>azwj</sup> Dismisses the affliction with a Dismissal’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/16)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, raising it, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Repels due to the supplication, the matter which He<sup>azwj</sup> Knows that it would be supplicated for, so He<sup>azwj</sup> would Answer; and if the servant does not supplicate in accordance to that, he would be hit from it (the affliction) what would bend his face to the earth’ (to humiliate him).

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:3
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَيَدْفَعُ بِالدُّعَاءِ الْأَمْرَ الَّذِي عَلِمَهُ أَنْ يُدْعَى لَهُ فَيَسْتَجِيبُ وَ لَوْ لَا مَا وُفِّقَ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الدُّعَاءِ لَأَصَابَهُ مِنْهُ مَا يَجُثُّهُ مِنْ جَدِيدِ الْأَرْضِ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, raising it, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Repels due to the supplication, the matter which He<sup>azwj</sup> Knows that it would be supplicated for, so He<sup>azwj</sup> would Answer; and if the servant does not supplicate in accordance to that, he would be hit from it (the affliction) what would bend his face to the earth’ (to humiliate him).

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Asbaat Bin Saalim, from Ala’a Bin Kaamil who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘It is upon you with the supplication, for it is a healing from every illness’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:4
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَلَيْكَ بِالدُّعَاءِ فَإِنَّهُ شِفَاءٌ مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Asbaat Bin Saalim, from Ala’a Bin Kaamil who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘It is upon you with the supplication, for it is a healing from every illness’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/17)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin isa, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Abdullah Bin Maymoun Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The supplication and pleading before Allah for help is the means of its acceptance just as clouds are means of rain’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:5
citation.arabic_text: الدُّعَاءُ كَهْفُ الْإِجَابَةِ كَمَا أَنَّ السَّحَابَ كَهْفُ الْمَطَرِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin isa, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Abdullah Bin Maymoun Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The supplication and pleading before Allah for help is the means of its acceptance just as clouds are means of rain’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/18)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘A servant would not bring out his hands to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, the Strong, the Compeller, except that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would be too Embarrassed that He<sup>azwj</sup> returns his hand empty until He<sup>azwj</sup> Makes it to be in it from the Grace of His<sup>azwj</sup> Mercy, whatever He<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires to. So whenever one of you supplicates, so he should not return his hand until he has wiped it upon his face and his head’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:5
citation.arabic_text: مَا أَبْرَزَ عَبْدٌ يَدَهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْجَبَّارِ إِلَّا اسْتَحْيَا اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَنْ يَرُدَّهَا صِفْراً حَتَّى يَجْعَلَ فِيهَا مِنْ فَضْلِ رَحْمَتِهِ مَا يَشَاءُ فَإِذَا دَعَا أَحَدُكُمْ فَلَا يَرُدَّ يَدَهُ حَتَّى يَمْسَحَ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ وَ رَأْسِهِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘A servant would not bring out his hands to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, the Strong, the Compeller, except that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would be too Embarrassed that He<sup>azwj</sup> returns his hand empty until He<sup>azwj</sup> Makes it to be in it from the Grace of His<sup>azwj</sup> Mercy, whatever He<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires to. So whenever one of you supplicates, so he should not return his hand until he has wiped it upon his face and his head’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/18)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Are you recognising the lengthening of the affliction from its shortening?’ We said, ‘No’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Whenever one of you is inspired for the supplication during the affliction, so he should know that the affliction is short (term)’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:6
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) هَلْ تَعْرِفُونَ طُولَ الْبَلَاءِ مِنْ قِصَرِهِ قُلْنَا لَا قَالَ إِذَا أُلْهِمَ أَحَدُكُمُ الدُّعَاءَ عِنْدَ الْبَلَاءِ فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ الْبَلَاءَ قَصِيرٌ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Are you recognising the lengthening of the affliction from its shortening?’ We said, ‘No’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Whenever one of you is inspired for the supplication during the affliction, so he should know that the affliction is short (term)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/21)

text: Muhamad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Wallad who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan Musaasws said: ‘There is none from an affliction descending upon a Momin servant, so Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Inspires him for the supplication, except that, that affliction would be Removed imminently; and there is none from an affliction descending upon a Momin servant, so he withholds from the supplication, except that, that affliction would be prolonged. So whenever the affliction descends, it would be upon you with the supplication and the pleading to Allahazwj’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:6
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى ( عليه السلام ) مَا مِنْ بَلَاءٍ يَنْزِلُ عَلَى عَبْدٍ مُؤْمِنٍ فَيُلْهِمُهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ الدُّعَاءَ إِلَّا كَانَ كَشْفُ ذَلِكَ الْبَلَاءِ وَشِيكاً وَ مَا مِنْ بَلَاءٍ يَنْزِلُ عَلَى عَبْدٍ مُؤْمِنٍ فَيُمْسِكُ عَنِ الدُّعَاءِ إِلَّا كَانَ ذَلِكَ الْبَلَاءُ طَوِيلًا فَإِذَا نَزَلَ الْبَلَاءُ فَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالدُّعَاءِ وَ التَّضَرُّعِ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ .
citation.translation: Muhamad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Wallad who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassan Musaasws said: ‘There is none from an affliction descending upon a Momin servant, so Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Inspires him for the supplication, except that, that affliction would be Removed imminently; and there is none from an affliction descending upon a Momin servant, so he withholds from the supplication, except that, that affliction would be prolonged. So whenever the affliction descends, it would be upon you with the supplication and the pleading to Allahazwj’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/22)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Hisham Bin Salim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who precedes regarding the supplication, it would be Answered for him when the affliction does descends with him, and the Angels would say, ‘A well-known voice not Veiled from the sky’; and the one who does not precede regarding the supplication, it would not be Answered for him when the affliction does descend with him, and the Angels would said, ‘That is a voice we do not recognise’’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:7
citation.arabic_text: مَنْ تَقَدَّمَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ إِذَا نَزَلَ بِهِ الْبَلَاءُ وَ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ صَوْتٌ مَعْرُوفٌ وَ لَمْ يُحْجَبْ عَنِ السَّمَاءِ وَ مَنْ لَمْ يَتَقَدَّمْ فِي الدُّعَاءِ لَمْ يُسْتَجَبْ لَهُ إِذَا نَزَلَ بِهِ الْبَلَاءُ وَ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ إِنَّ ذَا الصَّوْتَ لَا نَعْرِفُهُ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Hisham Bin Salim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who precedes regarding the supplication, it would be Answered for him when the affliction does descends with him, and the Angels would say, ‘A well-known voice not Veiled from the sky’; and the one who does not precede regarding the supplication, it would not be Answered for him when the affliction does descend with him, and the Angels would said, ‘That is a voice we do not recognise’’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/22)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Sinan, from Anbasa, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>: ‘The one who is fearful from an affliction hitting him, so he should precede regarding it with the supplication. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would not Show him the affliction, ever!’

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:7
citation.arabic_text: مَنْ تَخَوَّفَ مِنْ بَلَاءٍ يُصِيبُهُ فَتَقَدَّمَ فِيهِ بِالدُّعَاءِ لَمْ يُرِهِ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ ذَلِكَ الْبَلَاءَ أَبَداً .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Sinan, from Anbasa, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>: ‘The one who is fearful from an affliction hitting him, so he should precede regarding it with the supplication. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would not Show him the affliction, ever!’
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/22)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Mansour Bin Yunus, from Haroun Bin Kharija, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The supplication during the prosperity are instrumental for what one needs in the time of afflictions’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:7
citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ فِي الرَّخَاءِ يَسْتَخْرِجُ الْحَوَائِجَ فِي الْبَلَاءِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Mansour Bin Yunus, from Haroun Bin Kharija, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The supplication during the prosperity are instrumental for what one needs in the time of afflictions’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/22)

text: From him, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who is cheerful that it (supplication) should be Answered for him during the difficulties, so let him frequent the supplication during the prosperity’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:7
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُسْتَجَابَ لَهُ فِي الشِّدَّةِ فَلْيُكْثِرِ الدُّعَاءَ فِي الرَّخَاءِ .
citation.translation: From him, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who is cheerful that it (supplication) should be Answered for him during the difficulties, so let him frequent the supplication during the prosperity’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/23)

text: From him, from his father, from Ubeydullah Bin Yahya, from a man, from Abdul Hameed Bin Gawwas Al Tai’y, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> grandfather<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘Precede in the supplication, for the servant, when he was supplicating, and the affliction descends with him, so he supplicates, it is said (by the Angels), ‘A well-known voice’; and when he does not happen to supplicate, and the affliction descends with him, so he does supplicate, it is said (by the Angels), ‘Where were you before today?’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:7
citation.arabic_text: كَانَ جَدِّي يَقُولُ تَقَدَّمُوا فِي الدُّعَاءِ فَإِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا كَانَ دَعَّاءً فَنَزَلَ بِهِ الْبَلَاءُ فَدَعَا قِيلَ صَوْتٌ مَعْرُوفٌ وَ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ دَعَّاءً فَنَزَلَ بِهِ بَلَاءٌ فَدَعَا قِيلَ أَيْنَ كُنْتَ قَبْلَ الْيَوْمِ .
citation.translation: From him, from his father, from Ubeydullah Bin Yahya, from a man, from Abdul Hameed Bin Gawwas Al Tai’y, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> grandfather<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘Precede in the supplication, for the servant, when he was supplicating, and the affliction descends with him, so he supplicates, it is said (by the Angels), ‘A well-known voice’; and when he does not happen to supplicate, and the affliction descends with him, so he does supplicate, it is said (by the Angels), ‘Where were you before today?’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/23)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from the one who narrated it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 1<sup>st</sup> having said: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘One cannot benefit from a supplication after the descent of the affliction’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:7
citation.arabic_text: كَانَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ الدُّعَاءُ بَعْدَ مَا يَنْزِلُ الْبَلَاءُ لَا يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from the one who narrated it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 1<sup>st</sup> having said: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘One cannot benefit from a supplication after the descent of the affliction’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/23)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Suleym Al Fara’a, from the one who narrated it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When you supplicate, so think that (the fulfilment of) your need is at the door (imminent)’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:8
citation.arabic_text: إِذَا دَعَوْتَ فَظُنَّ أَنَّ حَاجَتَكَ بِالْبَابِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Suleym Al Fara’a, from the one who narrated it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When you supplicate, so think that (the fulfilment of) your need is at the door (imminent)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل وقد يعد حسن ا - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/23)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Suleyman Bin Amro who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic does not Answer a supplication manifested by an inattentive heart. So whenever you do supplicate, be attentive with your heart, then be convinced of it being Answered’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:9
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَا يَسْتَجِيبُ دُعَاءً بِظَهْرِ قَلْبٍ سَاهٍ فَإِذَا دَعَوْتَ فَأَقْبِلْ بِقَلْبِكَ ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقِنْ بِالْإِجَابَةِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Suleyman Bin Amro who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic does not Answer a supplication manifested by an inattentive heart. So whenever you do supplicate, be attentive with your heart, then be convinced of it being Answered’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/24)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic does not Accept a supplication of an unmindful heart’; and it was so that Ali<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘Whenever one of you supplicates for the deceased, so he should no supplicate for him while his heart is unmindful from him, but let him strive for him in the supplication’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:9
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( صلوات الله عليه ) لَا يَقْبَلُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ دُعَاءَ قَلْبٍ لَاهٍ وَ كَانَ عَلِيٌّ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ إِذَا دَعَا أَحَدُكُمْ لِلْمَيِّتِ فَلَا يَدْعُو لَهُ وَ قَلْبُهُ لَاهٍ عَنْهُ وَ لَكِنْ لِيَجْتَهِدْ لَهُ فِي الدُّعَاءِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic does not Accept a supplication of an unmindful heart’; and it was so that Ali<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘Whenever one of you supplicates for the deceased, so he should no supplicate for him while his heart is unmindful from him, but let him strive for him in the supplication’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/25)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from one of his companions, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Suleym Al Farra’a, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Whenever you supplicate, so be attentive with your heart and thinking that (the fulfilment of) your need is at the door (imminent)’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:9
citation.arabic_text: إِذَا دَعَوْتَ فَأَقْبِلْ بِقَلْبِكَ وَ ظُنَّ حَاجَتَكَ بِالْبَابِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from one of his companions, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Suleym Al Farra’a, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Whenever you supplicate, so be attentive with your heart and thinking that (the fulfilment of) your need is at the door (imminent)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/26)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic does not Answer a supplication manifested by a cruel heart’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:9
citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَا يَسْتَجِيبُ دُعَاءً بِظَهْرِ قَلْبٍ قَاسٍ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic does not Answer a supplication manifested by a cruel heart’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/26)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> supplicated for the rain and the people were drenched to the extent that they said, ‘It’s drowning (us)’, and Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said (gestured) by his<sup>saww</sup> hand and returned it: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Around us and not upon us!” He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘So the clouds dispersed, and they said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup>! You<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> supplicated for the rain for us but we were not quenched, then you<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> supplicated for the rain for us, so we were quenched’. He<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> said: ‘I<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> supplicated and there was no intention for me<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> during that, then I<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> supplicated, and for me<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> there was an intention regarding that’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:9
citation.arabic_text: لَمَّا اسْتَسْقَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) وَ سُقِيَ النَّاسُ حَتَّى قَالُوا إِنَّهُ الْغَرَقُ وَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) بِيَدِهِ وَ رَدَّهَا اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَ لَا عَلَيْنَا قَالَ فَتَفَرَّقَ السَّحَابُ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اسْتَسْقَيْتَ لَنَا فَلَمْ نُسْقَ ثُمَّ اسْتَسْقَيْتَ لَنَا فَسُقِينَا قَالَ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُ وَ لَيْسَ لِي فِي ذَلِكَ نِيَّةٌ ثُمَّ دَعَوْتُ وَ لِيَ فِي ذَلِكَ نِيَّةٌ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> supplicated for the rain and the people were drenched to the extent that they said, ‘It’s drowning (us)’, and Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said (gestured) by his<sup>saww</sup> hand and returned it: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Around us and not upon us!” He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘So the clouds dispersed, and they said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup>! You<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> supplicated for the rain for us but we were not quenched, then you<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> supplicated for the rain for us, so we were quenched’. He<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> said: ‘I<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> supplicated and there was no intention for me<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> during that, then I<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> supplicated, and for me<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> there was an intention regarding that’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/26)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Husayn Bin Atiyya, from Abdul Aziz Al Taweel who said, ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘A servant (of Allahazwj), when he supplicates, Allahazwj Blessed and High does not Cease to be in (the fulfilment) of his need for as long as he does not haste (in getting it Answered)’. Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Husayn Bin Atiyya, from Abdul Aziz Al Taweel, from Abu Abdullahasws – similar to it’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:10
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا دَعَا لَمْ يَزَلِ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى فِي حَاجَتِهِ مَا لَمْ يَسْتَعْجِلْ . مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ الطَّوِيلِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) مِثْلَهُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Husayn Bin Atiyya, from Abdul Aziz Al Taweel who said, ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘A servant (of Allahazwj), when he supplicates, Allahazwj Blessed and High does not Cease to be in (the fulfilment) of his need for as long as he does not haste (in getting it Answered)’. Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Husayn Bin Atiyya, from Abdul Aziz Al Taweel, from Abu Abdullahasws – similar to it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول بسندي ه - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/28)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim and Hafs Bin Al Bakhtary and others, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘A servant, when he makes haste (for its Answer), so he stands for his need, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High is Saying: “Does My<sup>azwj</sup> servant not know that I<sup>azwj</sup> am Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Fulfils the needs?”’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:10
citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا عَجَّلَ فَقَامَ لِحَاجَتِهِ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى أَ مَا يَعْلَمُ عَبْدِي أَنِّي أَنَا اللَّهُ الَّذِي أَقْضِي الْحَوَائِجَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim and Hafs Bin Al Bakhtary and others, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘A servant, when he makes haste (for its Answer), so he stands for his need, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High is Saying: “Does My<sup>azwj</sup> servant not know that I<sup>azwj</sup> am Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Fulfils the needs?”’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/30)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Muhammad Bin Marwan, from Al Waleed Bin Uqba Al Hajariy who said, ‘I heard Abu Ja’farasws saying: ‘By Allahazwj! A Momin servant will not insist upon Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic regarding his needs except Heazwj would Fulfil it for him’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:10
citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ وَ اللَّهِ لَا يُلِحُّ عَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنٌ عَلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِي حَاجَتِهِ إِلَّا قَضَاهَا لَهُ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Muhammad Bin Marwan, from Al Waleed Bin Uqba Al Hajariy who said, ‘I heard Abu Ja’farasws saying: ‘By Allahazwj! A Momin servant will not insist upon Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic regarding his needs except Heazwj would Fulfil it for him’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/30)

text: From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hajjal, from Hassan, from Abu Al Sabbah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Dislikes the people insisting before one another for help but He<sup>azwj</sup> Loves that for Himself<sup>azwj</sup> that He<sup>azwj</sup> should be asked (from), and He<sup>azwj</sup> be sought for what is with Him<sup>azwj</sup>’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:10
citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ كَرِهَ إِلْحَاحَ النَّاسِ بَعْضِهِمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ فِي الْمَسْأَلَةِ وَ أَحَبَّ ذَلِكَ لِنَفْسِهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يُحِبُّ أَنْ يُسْأَلَ وَ يُطْلَبَ مَا عِنْدَهُ .
citation.translation: From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hajjal, from Hassan, from Abu Al Sabbah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Dislikes the people insisting before one another for help but He<sup>azwj</sup> Loves that for Himself<sup>azwj</sup> that He<sup>azwj</sup> should be asked (from), and He<sup>azwj</sup> be sought for what is with Him<sup>azwj</sup>’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (2/30)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Husayn Al Ahmasy, from a man, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘No, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! No servant (of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>) would insist upon Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic except Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Answer for him’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:10
citation.arabic_text: لَا وَ اللَّهِ لَا يُلِحُّ عَبْدٌ عَلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَّا اسْتَجَابَ اللَّهُ لَهُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Husayn Al Ahmasy, from a man, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘No, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! No servant (of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>) would insist upon Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic except Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Answer for him’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/31)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘May Allahazwj be Merciful upon a servant who seeks a need from Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic, so he is insistent in the supplication, whether is it Answered for him or not Answered for him’; and heasws recited this Verse [19:48] And I will withdraw from you and what you call on besides Allah, and I will call upon my Lord, perhaps I shall not remain unblessed in calling upon my Lord’.

citation.chapter: THE BOOK OF SUPPLICATION (al-Kafi, vol 2), 2:10
citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) رَحِمَ اللَّهُ عَبْداً طَلَبَ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ حَاجَةً فَأَلَحَّ فِي الدُّعَاءِ اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ أَوْ لَمْ يُسْتَجَبْ لَهُ وَ تَلَا هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ وَ أَدْعُوا رَبِّي عَسى أَلَّا أَكُونَ بِدُعاءِ رَبِّي شَقِيًّا .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘May Allahazwj be Merciful upon a servant who seeks a need from Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic, so he is insistent in the supplication, whether is it Answered for him or not Answered for him’; and heasws recited this Verse [19:48] And I will withdraw from you and what you call on besides Allah, and I will call upon my Lord, perhaps I shall not remain unblessed in calling upon my Lord’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (12/31)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Abdullah Al Fara’a, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Knows what the servant wants when he supplicates to Him<sup>azwj</sup>, but He<sup>azwj</sup> Loves it that the need be transmitted to Him<sup>azwj</sup>. Therefore, whenever you supplicate, so specify your need’.
